title: Sales Manager II
description:
Swiggy is India's leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500 cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014 to becoming a logistics hub of excellence today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees. With Swiggy's New Supply and the recent launches of Swiggy Instamart, Swiggy Genie, and Guiltfree, we are consistently making waves in the market while continually growing the opportunities we offer our people. \*We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law
  
  
**Job Description**
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants—learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
* Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
* Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
* Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
* Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
* Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
* Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
* Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

**Qualifications**

* 0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
* Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
* Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
* Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
* Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

* Coordinate with Marketing on lead generation campaigns, prospect lists, and outreach messaging.

* Send follow-up emails to prospects with meeting summaries, next steps, and relevant company presentations.
* Support the Sales Team with account research, prospect information, and contact verification.
* Maintain regular engagement with potential customers and nurture leads until they are ready for further sales discussions.

* **Lead Generation:**

3. Strong verbal communication skills and confidence in making outbound calls to potential customers.
4. Good written communication skills for professional emails and LinkedIn outreach.
5. Familiarity with Microsoft Teams and CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho.
6. Basic proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and other productivity tools.
7. Ability to understand and communicate Bharat Managed Services’ offerings, including IT Support, Field Services (FSO), Digital Workplace, and Infrastructure Services.

9. A target-oriented mindset with persistence and the ability to handle rejection positively.
10. Excellent organizational, time-management, communication, and relationship-building skills.

title: Market Development Specialist
description:
🇺🇸 US Market Development & Field Sales Executive

Chennai, India + USA | 6 Months India / 6 Months USA

We are looking for highly articulate, commercially driven and research-oriented sales professionals to join our US healthcare business development team.

This is a unique opportunity for professionals who want to build a long-term career in US B2B sales and business development.

The role will be divided approximately equally between India and the USA:

6 months in India: Research, prospect identification, account intelligence, pre-sales and pipeline development.

6 months in the USA: In-person meetings, relationship building, field sales, conferences and business development.

🇮🇳 Your role in India – Pre-Sales & Pipeline Development

You will be responsible for doing the detailed groundwork before an opportunity reaches the US sales team.

You will:

* Research target US healthcare organizations
* Understand the company's business model, size, locations, services and estimated revenue
* Research the organization's current business challenges and potential areas of opportunity
* Identify the right decision-makers and influencers
* Research executives and their backgrounds
* Identify verified contact information
* Build detailed account/prospect profiles
* Identify potential buying signals and business opportunities
* Conduct LinkedIn, email and telephone outreach
* Qualify prospects
* Develop relationships with prospects before the sales team engages
* Schedule qualified meetings
* Maintain detailed CRM information
* Prepare account intelligence and briefing notes for the US sales team
* Continuously build a qualified pipeline

The objective is not simply to generate leads.

The objective is to deliver well-researched, qualified business opportunities to the US sales team.

🇺🇸 Your role in the USA – Field Sales & Business Development

During your US assignment, you will transition into a client-facing role.

You will:

* Meet prospects and decision-makers in person
* Visit healthcare organizations
* Conduct business development meetings
* Attend conferences and industry events
* Build executive relationships
* Follow up on opportunities developed during your India phase
* Identify new business opportunities
* Participate in discovery meetings
* Support presentations and proposals
* Work closely with the US sales leadership
* Develop opportunities through the sales cycle
* Represent Scintillate professionally in the US market

🎯 Strict Qualification Criteria

We are looking for a very specific profile. Please apply only if you meet most of the following requirements.

* Education
  Postgraduate degree is mandatory
* MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Sales, Business Development, International Business, Healthcare Management or a related discipline preferred
* Candidates with strong academic backgrounds and relevant postgraduate specialization will be preferred
* Experience
  3–7 years of relevant experience
* Prior experience in US-focused pre-sales, business development, inside sales, lead generation or market research is mandatory
* Experience selling into the US market is strongly preferred
* Experience dealing with US healthcare organizations, healthcare services, RCM, DMEPOS, medical billing, healthcare IT, BPO or SaaS will be a significant advantage
* Candidates must have experience independently researching US prospects and identifying decision-makers
* Experience using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Crunchbase or similar sales intelligence/prospecting platforms preferred
* Hands-on experience working with a CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Nutshell or similar

🗣️ Communication — Critical Requirement

Excellent English communication skills are mandatory.

The candidate must be:

* Extremely articulate and confident in spoken English
* Comfortable speaking with US C-level executives, VPs, Directors and business owners
* Able to conduct a professional discovery conversation
* Able to ask intelligent business questions
* Able to understand and respond to different US accents
* Able to communicate clearly without excessive reliance on scripts
* Strong in business writing, including emails and LinkedIn communication
* Comfortable presenting information to senior executives
* Able to communicate professionally in person as well as virtually

Candidates with weak spoken English or limited experience communicating with US business executives will not be considered.

🔎 Research & Analytical Skills

This is equally important.

The candidate should be able to take a company name and independently answer:

Who are they?

What do they do?

How large are they?

What is their approximate revenue?

Where do they operate?

Who makes the decision?

What problems might they have?

Why would they potentially need our services?

Who else should we speak with?

You should enjoy researching companies and people, not just making calls.

* ✈️ Mobility & Travel
  Must be willing and able to spend approximately 6 months each year in the USA
* Must be comfortable with frequent domestic travel within the US
* Must be comfortable conducting face-to-face meetings with senior executives
* Must be willing to attend conferences, trade shows and networking events
* Appropriate US travel/work authorization will be required for the activities undertaken during the US assignment

⭐ The person we are looking for

We are not looking for a conventional telesales executive.

We are looking for someone who combines:

Researcher + Pre-Sales Professional + Business Development Executive + Relationship Builder + Field Salesperson

Someone who can spend Monday morning researching a 500-employee healthcare company, understand its business, identify its CFO/COO/VP Revenue Cycle, build an intelligent outreach strategy — and six months later sit across the table from that executive in the United States and have a meaningful business conversation.

If you are highly articulate, commercially curious, comfortable with senior executives and genuinely interested in the US market, this could be an excellent opportunity to build a long-term international sales career.

📍 Base: Chennai, India

🇺🇸 US Assignment: Approximately 6 months annually

💼 Experience: 3–7 years

🎓 Postgraduate qualification: Mandatory

🇺🇸 US pre-sales/business development experience: Mandatory

🏥 US Healthcare experience: Strongly preferred

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in selling IT staffing or staff augmentation services, generating new business opportunities, engaging client decision-makers, and closing staffing contracts.

This role is best suited for a sales professional with a strong hunter mentality, an established network or the ability to build one, and a proven ability to generate staffing revenue.

* Identify, prospect, and acquire new clients for IT staffing, contract staffing, and staff augmentation services.
* Generate qualified leads through cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, networking, referrals, and industry connections.
* Identify organizations with ongoing or upcoming IT resource requirements and develop targeted business opportunities.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers, including CIOs, CTOs, IT Directors, Engineering Managers, Talent Acquisition Heads, HR leaders, and vendor management teams.

* Understand client hiring needs, technical skill requirements, contract duration, resource volumes, location preferences, and commercial expectations.
* Develop and manage a strong sales pipeline, from initial prospecting through opportunity qualification, negotiation, and contract closure.

* Coordinate closely with recruitment and delivery teams to communicate client requirements, validate candidate availability, and support timely fulfilment.
* Follow up on submitted profiles, interviews, offers, onboarding, extensions, and additional resource requests to grow client accounts.
* Foster client relationships and account expansion.
* Monitor staffing market trends, competitor activities, client demand, and emerging skill requirements.
* Achieve agreed targets for new client acquisition, staffing requirements, placements, gross margin, and revenue.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Any graduate with excellent communication.
* Proven experience in business development or sales within IT staffing, staff augmentation, contract staffing, or recruitment services.
* Strong understanding of the Technical IT staffing business model, including bill rates, pay rates, gross margins, contract terms, and resource fulfilment.
* Demonstrated experience in new client acquisition and generating staffing business from new accounts.
* Experience engaging enterprise clients, staffing partners, vendor management organizations, and talent acquisition leaders.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, networking, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to client onboarding and account growth.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, sales pipeline management, and business reporting.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be measured against:

* Number of new clients acquired and successfully onboarded.
* Number of qualified staffing opportunities and active client requirements generated.
* Number of client requirements converted into successful resource deployments.
* Revenue and gross margin generated from staffing engagements.
* Number of client empanelment's and contracts secured.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will independently build a pipeline of prospective staffing clients, establish strong relationships with decision-makers, secure new staffing contracts, and generate sustainable revenue through successful IT resource deployments and long-term client partnerships.

What if your next job could help someone tick off their bucket list? Think about it.

One day, you’re helping a couple plan their dream honeymoon in Bali. The next, you’re helping a family book the vacation they’ve been saving for all year. * You’re adaptable and can handle the excitement and unpredictability of a startup.
* You believe learning never stops.

* A Startup Culture where your impact is visible and your growth is in your hands.

title: Luxury retail sales associate
description:
***Suit Lounge - Bespoke Beyond Measure.***

**Suit Lounge is a luxury bespoke menswear house, born in Chennai in 2023. Our signature experience centre in T. Nagar is where every suit, shirt, trouser, ceremonial piece and couture wedding ensemble is made to measure.**

**We source only from Woolmark-certified mills across Europe. Our suiting is cut from high-end worsted merino, cashmere, mohair, vicuña and rare luxury blends from the United Kingdom, France and Italy. Our shirting uses the finest cotton, linen and silk from Italy, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.**

***The role***

**As a Luxury Sales Stylist, you’ll be at the front of one of the city’s most exclusive client books. Your clients include film personalities, celebrity stylists, industrialists, entrepreneurs, and grooms, along with their families.**

**This is a fast-paced, high-pressure sales role in a brand that is scaling quickly. You’ll learn to advise and close clients for whom price is rarely the first question, and for whom quality, experience, discretion and service matter most.**

**Few people get this level of access this early in their careers. Fewer get trained for it. We hire rarely, and we hire few.**

***Please Read this first:***

* ***This is a retail sales role.***
  Your main job is to sell bespoke menswear and own each client’s journey until delivery and beyond.
* Styling knowledge is a tool you use to sell. It isn’t the job itself.
* You’re responsible for every client’s experience and styling, from first hello to final fitting.
* ***Behave like an owner, you own the customer's journey.***
* **If you want a design only role from a desk, this isn’t it.**

**What you get**

* Direct training from the founder and senior leadership.
* Deep knowledge of fabrics, Tailoring, construction, fit, and wardrobe planning.
* Experience selling luxury and handling premium clients.
* Work alongside world-class mills in EU.
* Meeting Ultra High net worth individuals and access to elite clientele and their network.
* Lots of Networking Opportunities.
* A clear growth path: Sales Stylist → Store Head → Regional Head → VP Sales.
* Fixed salary plus sales incentive.

**What you’ll do**

* **Sell:**
   consult clients, recommend fabrics and styles to fit their needs, and close the sale.
* **Deliver:**
   coordinate the order through production, fittings, and delivery.
* **Retain:**
   follow up, collect feedback, and bring clients back for their next order.

**Who we’re looking for**

* Freshers welcome. 1+ year of retail experience is a plus.
* Fluent English (written and spoken), plus conversational Tamil and Hindi.
* Confident and clear when speaking to strangers.
* Proactive, disciplined, and punctual.
* **Hungry to earn through sales**
  and to build a career in it.
* Organized and detail-oriented.

**ALL THE BEST.**

Company Description:

LMES Academy Pvt Ltd is a leading EdTech company based in Chennai, committed to making learning fun, engaging, and concept-driven. We focus on simplifying science and technology through our STEM-based courses designed for students from Grades 1 to 8.

Beyond our STEM learning programs, we also offer innovative educational platforms such as:

* Chitti Future School – A flagship Pan-India learning initiative that also serves international students, offering industry-relevant and future-focused programs in STEM, coding, AI, robotics, communication, and other emerging technologies. The program is designed to help students develop practical skills, creativity, critical thinking, and global competencies through engaging online and offline learning experiences.
* Chitti Experience Center – An immersive experiential learning center where students gain hands-on exposure to STEM, robotics, coding, AI, electronics, and innovation-based projects through interactive workshops and practical activities.
* Chitti Play School – An early childhood education program focused on providing a safe, engaging, and stimulating environment where young learners develop cognitive, social, emotional, and motor skills through play-based learning.
* Chitti NEET/JEE – A comprehensive coaching program designed to help students excel in competitive entrance examinations through expert faculty, structured study plans, regular assessments, personalized mentoring, and performance tracking.

At LMES, we believe in inspiring curiosity, nurturing young minds, and creating a lasting impact through practical education.

About the Role:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and results-driven Business Development Executive to join our EdTech team. The ideal candidate will engage with parents and students through Google Meet, explain our STEM-based learning programs for Grades 1 to 8, and guide them to enroll in our courses.

Key Responsibilities:

* Conduct engaging online counselling sessions with students and parents via Google Meet to present our educational programs and career pathways.

* Build strong relationships with prospective students and parents by providing personalized guidance and addressing their queries with confidence.
* Drive the complete sales cycle—from lead engagement and counselling to successful enrollment—ensuring a seamless customer experience.
* Consistently follow up with prospective leads through calls, emails, WhatsApp, and virtual meetings to maximize conversion rates.
* Achieve and exceed weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales and enrollment targets.

* Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and product knowledge to effectively position the company's programs.

 Bachelor's degree in any discipline is mandatory. Candidates with a background in Science, Electronics, or Engineering will be preferred.

title: Sales Engineer (Inside Sales)
description:
**Job Description**
Help engineers, startups and manufacturers turn their ideas into real products. Customers come to 3Ding through the website, phone, WhatsApp and walk-ins, so there's no cold calling. You'll understand what each customer is building, help them choose the right way to make it, and stay with them until their order is delivered.
  
  
**About 3Ding**

* In 3D printing and manufacturing since 2013, and one of India's leading 3D printing companies. Over 30,000 3D printers sold and more than 10 million parts made, for customers like ISRO, DRDO, the IITs, Tata and Bosch.
* 3Ding sells 3D printers, scanners and materials, and runs an online 3D printing and manufacturing service with instant quotes.
* Rated 4.8 on Google from over 800 reviews.

**Why join 3Ding**

* Interesting conversations, every day. 3Ding's projects range from designing and manufacturing a spoon for Oru Spoon, to helping make Jai Hind 1S, one of the world's lightest satellites, to prototyping automobile parts for Ather and Mahindra. Every customer brings a different idea, and you help them find the best way to make it.
* Learn 3D printing and modern manufacturing properly: the main 3D printing methods (FDM, resin, SLS, MJF and metal), the materials, and how companies use them. 3Ding trains you from the start, and it's a skill few people in India have.
* A small team that decides quickly. Little hierarchy, and new ideas and experiments are welcome.
* Latest tech, built in-house. 3Ding's own development team keeps bringing in new tools and AI, so routine work is automated and your time goes to productive work.
* Room to grow. Your role grows as you take on bigger accounts and more responsibility. Pay is reviewed every year.

**What You'll Do**

* Reply to enquiries quickly, on phone, WhatsApp, email and the website
* Find out what the customer is building and suggest the right 3D printer, material or manufacturing method
* Send quotes and estimates, and follow up until the order is confirmed
* Follow up on payments until they're received
* Keep customers updated until delivery, working with the production team, who make and ship each order
* Once in a while, visit a customer in or around Chennai when they ask (rare, and travel is covered)

**Requirements**
**You'll do well here if you**

* Have 1 to 3 years of experience in sales, customer support or a technical role
* Speak and write English well. You'll talk to engineers and purchase managers every day.
* Have a technical background: an engineering or science degree, or work experience at a technical company (machines, electronics, IT hardware, industrial products)
* Are comfortable on calls and WhatsApp most of the day, and actually follow up

**Nice to have**

* You can talk to customers in Hindi, since many of them are from outside Tamil Nadu
* Any experience with 3D printing

**Benefits**

* ₹25,000 to ₹30,000 a month in hand, depending on experience
* Variable pay of up to 20% of your salary, based on the sales you help close
* Health insurance for you and your spouse or 1 dependent, after your 90-day probation
* A MacBook for work
* 12 days of paid leave a year (3 each quarter), plus 12 public holidays

**Working days:**
Monday to Friday and alternate Saturdays, 9 am to 6 pm.
  
  
**Where:**
K5, 7th Street, Ambattur Industrial Estate, Chennai 600058. This is an in-office role.
  
  
**Hiring process:**
a short phone call in English, a small practical task, and a final interview.

title: Business Development Intern
description:
**VADIVAM®**
is a strategic brand identity studio. We design brand identities for established enterprises — founder-led, multi-generational and listed businesses.

**IMPORTANT: LinkedIn Easy Apply applications will not be reviewed. To apply, email your application to careers@vadivam.com as described under "How to Apply" below.**

**ABOUT VADIVAM®**

VADIVAM® began in 2013 as a freelance creative practice and was incorporated in 2018. Over 13 years, we've delivered 200+ brand projects, built a strong network of creative collaborators and partners, and worked across a wide range of creative disciplines.

We are now entering a deliberate new phase: repositioning VADIVAM® as a premium brand identity design agency for established enterprises, founder-led and multi-generational businesses — moving away from being seen as a general branding, logo or digital creative agency.

**THE TEAM AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT**

This phase is being built with a focused, lean team that will grow with the studio. You would work alongside identity designers, an editor and a fellow intern, in-office.

• Role type: Full-time internship, in-office

• Working hours: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

• Saturdays: alternate Saturdays off; the monthly office calendar is shared in advance

• Detailed policies are shared at the final stage of joining

As we build through this phase, we're structuring resources carefully to create an efficient, sustainable team. The environment is focused and collaborative, with real ownership and a direct hand in shaping how the studio evolves.

**ROLE AT A GLANCE**

• Role: Business Development Intern (2 positions)

• Location: Chennai — studio-based, near Teynampet Metro, with occasional client travel

• Stipend: ₹14,000/month fixed

• Growth path: structured performance review at 6 months, leading to an extended internship with a revised stipend or confirmation as a full-time employee

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Responsibilities span brand marketing and business growth. Each intern's focus will be shaped around their strengths.

• Research established enterprises and identify key decision-makers as potential clients

• Build qualified prospect lists and track business signals such as expansions and leadership changes

• Run personalised outreach, book appointments and manage follow-ups

• Prepare client research briefs and pitch presentations

• Attend client meetings with the founder

• Maintain the sales pipeline and support client relationship management

• Manage VADIVAM®'s digital platforms — monitoring, content publishing and promotion

• Write "Blog Insights" — industry updates and perspectives

• Plan targeted campaigns that reach premium clients

• Maintain and update VADIVAM®'s website, and grow traffic to our platforms

• Support networking, partnerships and lead generation

**APPLY ONLY IF**

• You're a final-year student or recent graduate in business, marketing, communication or a related field

• You write clear, precise English and speak with confidence; Tamil is an advantage

• You're comfortable engaging with senior business leaders

• You're curious about how brands communicate and how businesses grow

• You're organised and follow through without reminders

• You can work full-time from our Chennai studio

**THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF**

• You're looking for a short certificate internship, or remote or part-time work

• Your interest is mainly in running ads, chasing follower counts or high-volume telecalling

**WHAT WE OFFER**

• A fixed monthly stipend of ₹14,000

• A structured review at 6 months, with a path to full-time employment

• On confirmation: a retention bonus at 12 months and an annual appraisal

• Hands-on exposure to premium brand strategy and B2B growth

• Direct mentorship from the founder, including client meetings with business leaders

This role requires someone who is comfortable speaking with business owners, decision-makers, managers, and other stakeholders. You should be able to explain technical product features in simple business language and demonstrate how our solutions help businesses improve operational efficiency.
  
  
We are looking for someone who is not satisfied with simply making calls or generating leads.
**You should be motivated by sales closures, revenue generation, customer acquisition, and achieving ambitious targets.**

* Key Responsibilities
* ERP & POS Product Knowledge
* Develop a strong understanding of GwayERP.
* Learn the features, functionalities, modules, pricing, benefits, and use cases of each product.
* Understand how ERP systems help businesses manage their daily operations.
* Learn the end-to-end workflows of different ERP modules.
* Understand the difference between standard product features, configurable workflows, and customization requirements.
* Identify which product and modules are most suitable for a prospect's business.
* Stay updated on product enhancements, new features, pricing, and approved promotional offers.
* Continuously improve product knowledge through internal training, hands-on practice, and demonstrations.

**Expectation:**
You must be able to explain the product confidently without depending entirely on technical team members.
  
  

* Client Communication & Product Demonstrations
* Communicate with prospective clients through telephone calls, WhatsApp, email, online meetings, and other approved channels.
* Conduct product demonstrations for interested prospects.
* Explain product features, modules, workflows, and business benefits in a clear and professional manner.
* Demonstrate relevant features based on the prospect's business requirements.
* Explain product pricing, licensing, implementation scope, and customization options using approved company information.
* Answer common product-related questions and address client concerns.
* Understand when a question requires technical clarification and coordinate with the relevant team.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the sales process.
* Adapt communication to different client profiles, industries, and levels of technical knowledge.
* Multilingual Sales Communication

Fluency in all three languages is essential for this position.
  
  

* Communicate confidently in English, Tamil, and Hindi.
* Conduct product demonstrations and sales discussions in the language most comfortable for the client.
* Explain complex product features in simple, understandable language.
* Prepare and deliver sales presentations appropriate to the audience.
* Communicate professionally with business owners, senior management, and operational teams.
* Write clear business emails and follow-up messages in English.
* Switch between languages when required to improve client understanding and engagement.

**Language requirement:**
Candidates must demonstrate practical speaking and comprehension skills in English, Tamil, and Hindi. Basic conversational familiarity alone may not be sufficient for client-facing sales discussions.
  
  

* Lead Follow-Up & Qualification
* Contact inbound leads generated through marketing campaigns, websites, referrals, and other channels.
* Identify potential customers through outbound prospecting and approved lead-generation activities.
* Understand the prospect's industry, business size, operational challenges, and software requirements.
* Qualify prospects based on business needs, decision-making authority, budget, urgency, and purchase intent.
* Follow up consistently with interested prospects.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, discussions, requirements, objections, and next actions.
* Prioritize qualified prospects and high-intent opportunities.
* Re-engage prospects who have shown interest but have not yet made a purchasing decision.
* Ensure that no qualified lead is neglected because of poor follow-up.
* Requirement Understanding & Solution Presentation
* Understand the prospect's current business processes and operational challenges.
* Ask relevant questions to identify the problems the client wants to solve.
* Map client requirements to the appropriate ERP or POS product features.
* Identify the modules relevant to the prospect's business.
* Explain how the proposed solution addresses the client's requirements.
* Distinguish between existing product functionality and requirements that may need customization.
* Coordinate with the product or technical team when detailed feasibility clarification is required.
* Communicate the proposed solution accurately without making unauthorized commitments.
* Present the business value of the solution rather than focusing only on technical specifications.
* Sales Conversion & Deal Closure

**Sales Closure Is a Primary Responsibility Of This Role.**

* Convert qualified leads into paying customers.
* Develop a clear understanding of the client's buying process and decision criteria.
* Follow up after demonstrations, quotations, and commercial discussions.
* Identify and address objections related to pricing, product functionality, competition, and implementation.
* Communicate the value proposition and return on investment of the product.
* Create appropriate urgency using genuine business benefits and approved promotional offers.
* Engage decision-makers and identify the next steps required to close each opportunity.
* Maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle.
* Negotiate within company-approved pricing and commercial guidelines.
* Obtain internal approval for discounts or commercial exceptions when required.
* Coordinate with the relevant teams to complete the necessary documentation and payment process.
* Maintain ownership of opportunities until the agreed sales outcome is achieved.

**Expected mindset:**
Do not treat a product demonstration as the end of the sales process. Every qualified opportunity should have a clear next step toward a purchasing decision.
  
  

* Sales Pipeline & CRM Management
* Maintain an updated record of prospects and opportunities in the designated CRM or sales tracking system.
* Record lead sources, contact information, business requirements, communication history, and follow-up dates.
* Update the sales stage of every active opportunity.
* Maintain a clear follow-up schedule.
* Track demonstrations, quotations, negotiations, and pending decisions.
* Prepare daily and weekly sales activity reports.
* Identify stalled opportunities and develop suitable follow-up strategies.
* Provide accurate sales forecasts based on actual pipeline status.
* Ensure that lead and customer information is accurate and organized.
* Outbound Sales & Business Development
* Conduct outbound calls and prospecting activities.
* Identify potential customers across relevant industries.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective ERP and POS customers.
* Explore opportunities through referrals, business networks, industry contacts, and approved digital channels.
* Reach out to business owners, operations managers, finance managers, and other relevant decision-makers.
* Support email and WhatsApp sales campaigns.
* Follow up on leads generated through Meta Ads, website enquiries, and other marketing activities.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling or upselling additional modules and products where appropriate.
* Share customer feedback and market observations with the sales and marketing teams.
* Target Achievement & Performance
* Work toward assigned daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Maintain consistent sales activity and follow-up discipline.
* Focus on qualified opportunities and conversion rates rather than call volume alone.
* Improve product demonstrations and objection-handling skills based on sales outcomes.
* Monitor individual performance against agreed targets.
* Identify reasons for lost deals and apply lessons to future opportunities.
* Take responsibility for assigned sales opportunities and agreed revenue goals.
* Demonstrate a strong commitment to achieving sales targets.

The company will establish measurable targets based on product category, lead availability, pricing, sales cycle, and market conditions.
  
  

* Coordination with Internal Teams
* Coordinate with the product team for product-related clarifications.
* Work with the UI/UX and business analysis team when client requirements need detailed evaluation.
* Coordinate with developers or technical specialists for approved technical discussions.
* Share client feedback and feature requests with the appropriate team.
* Coordinate with marketing regarding campaign leads and promotional activities.
* Work with the implementation team during customer handover.
* Ensure that customer expectations and agreed commercial terms are communicated accurately.
* Avoid promising features, delivery dates, or customization commitments without the required approval.
* Required Skills
* Language & Communication
* Fluent in English, Tamil, and Hindi.
* Strong verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain software products in simple business language.
* Confidence in conducting telephone conversations and online demonstrations.
* Good English writing skills for emails, proposals, and follow-up messages.
* Professional communication and active listening.
* Sales Skills
* Strong interest in sales and business development.
* Persuasion and negotiation skills.
* Ability to handle objections professionally.
* Confidence in asking for the sale and moving opportunities toward closure.
* Ability to identify decision-makers and understand buying intent.
* Strong follow-up and time-management skills.
* Resilience when prospects reject an offer or delay a decision.
* Willingness to work toward measurable targets.
* Product & Technical Learning
* Ability to understand software products and business applications.
* Interest in ERP, POS, CRM, and business management systems.
* Ability to learn product modules, workflows, features, and pricing.
* Logical thinking and requirement-understanding skills.
* Willingness to participate in product training and practice demonstrations.
* Ability to connect product features with real business problems.
* Personal Attributes
* Ambitious and results-oriented.
* Self-motivated and disciplined.
* Persistent without being unprofessional or pushy.
* Accountable for assigned targets and opportunities.
* Comfortable interacting with different types of customers.
* Open to feedback and continuous learning.
* Organized in maintaining sales records and follow-up activities.
* Focused on customer value, long-term relationships, and revenue generation.
* Eligibility Criteria
* Any bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
* Freshers and candidates with up to two years of experience may apply.
* Fluency in English, Tamil, and Hindi is mandatory.
* Prior sales experience in ERP, SaaS, software, IT services, or POS products is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with email, spreadsheets, and online meeting tools.
* Willingness to learn software products and conduct product demonstrations.
* A strong interest in sales closure and target achievement.

Candidates with no prior ERP experience may apply if they demonstrate strong communication skills, learning ability, commercial awareness, and a genuine interest in sales.
  
  

* Performance Evaluation

**Performance Will Be Evaluated Using Measurable Indicators Such As**

* Quality and consistency of lead follow-up.
* Number of qualified leads generated or handled.
* Product knowledge and demonstration quality.
* Lead-to-demonstration conversion rate.
* Demonstration-to-sale conversion rate.
* Number of successful sales closures.
* Revenue generated against assigned targets.
* Follow-up discipline and CRM accuracy.
* Ability to handle objections and move opportunities forward.
* Customer feedback and professionalism.
* Accuracy of commitments and quality of customer handover.

Performance should be assessed using both sales outcomes and the quality of the sales process.
  
  

* What Makes You a Good Fit?

**You Are a Strong Fit For This Position If**

* You genuinely enjoy selling and persuading customers through value.
* You are confident speaking with business owners and decision-makers.
* You can learn a product thoroughly and explain it clearly.
* You do not give up after one unanswered call or an initial rejection.
* You follow up professionally until the customer makes a decision.
* You understand that sales requires preparation, discipline, persistence, and relationship building.
* You are comfortable working with targets and being accountable for results.
* You are ambitious about growing your sales skills, income, and career.
* You want to become a sales professional who can independently manage opportunities from the first conversation to closure.
* Career Growth

**This Role Offers Practical Exposure To**

* ERP and POS product sales.
* Business-to-business sales.
* Product demonstrations and solution selling.
* Lead qualification and pipeline management.
* Commercial negotiations and deal closure.
* Customer relationship management.
* ERP business processes and industry requirements.
* Sales strategy and business development.

High-performing employees can progress into senior sales, account management, business development, or sales management roles based on their performance and capabilities.

Interested candidates can apply through our official recruitment website.

title: Lead Qualification Representative
description:
Location: Remote
  
  
Schedule: Full-time, EST Business Hours Required
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$40,000–C$50,000 annually, based on performance and qualifications
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Langford Staffing is recruiting experienced outbound calling professionals to qualify consumers and connect eligible individuals with licensed representatives through live transfers.
  
  
This is a performance-focused position for someone who can communicate confidently, think quickly, handle objections and remain professional during continuous high-volume calling.
  
  
You will not provide licensed advice or complete customer enrolments. Your responsibility is to qualify consumers, obtain their permission and complete an accurate live transfer.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Contact consumer leads using an outbound dialer.
* Follow campaign scripts, introductions and compliance requirements.
* Ask focused questions to determine whether consumers meet campaign requirements.
* Explain the reason for the call clearly and professionally.
* Handle hesitation, objections, rejection and difficult conversations.
* Obtain permission and complete warm live transfers.
* Remain on the call until the receiving representative accepts the handoff.
* Record accurate notes, dispositions, outcomes and follow-up requirements.
* Handle unsuccessful transfers and callbacks according to campaign procedures.
* Apply feedback from call reviews, coaching and performance reporting.
* Learn and work across different consumer-service campaigns.

**Required Experience**

* Three or more years of recent high-volume outbound calling experience.
* Experience qualifying leads and completing warm or live transfers.
* A history of achieving measurable call, qualification or transfer targets.
* Experience using Convoso, Five9, NICE CXone, Genesys Cloud CX, CallTools, Readymode or a comparable dialer.
* Strong understanding of call dispositions, callbacks, holds, consultation calls and live transfers.
* Experience maintainingaccurate CRM records while speaking with consumers.
* Strong listening, communication and objection-handling skills.
* Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with rejection or abusive callers.
* Ability to type at least 35 net words per minute with strong accuracy.
* Verifiable employment history and professional references.
* Availability to work the assigned full-time campaign schedule.

Experience in insurance, health-benefit programs, telecommunications, financial services, consumer services or another regulated calling environment is an asset.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.
  
  
Selected candidates may also be asked to complete a typing test, equipment check, reference check, call role-play and live skills interview.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
**Performance Will Be Measured Through**

* Accepted and properly qualified live transfers
* Consistent progress toward campaign production targets
* Call quality and compliance
* Accurate CRM notes and dispositions
* Productive dialer activity
* Attendance and schedule reliability
* Professional objection handling
* Improvement following coaching and call reviews

Representatives may be expected to produce approximately five accepted qualified transfers per dialing hour, depending on the campaign.
  
  
Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person is confident, resilient, organized and comfortable speaking with a high volume of consumers every day.
  
  
You should be able to recover quickly from rejection, follow a structured process and sound natural rather than scripted. You must maintain quality while working toward demanding performance targets and remain professional when consumers become impatient, suspicious or disrespectful.
  
  
Remote Technology Requirements
  
  
**You Must Have**

* A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM
* A dual-monitor setup
* Reliable internet with a speed of at least 100 Mbps
* A backup internet connection or power solution
* A wired, noise-cancelling USB headset
* A webcam
* A quiet, private and professional workspace

description:
**Job Opening: Sales & Reservations Executive

ELO House

Location: Chennai

Experience: 5 - 10years

Employment: Full-time

Industry: Accommodation, Residential Rentals & Hospitality

About ELO House

ELO House is an extended-stay housing platform offering fully furnished private rooms, studios, apartments and residential homes for stays ranging from a few days to several months.

We help customers find homes that match their budget, location, duration and living requirements.

We are looking for a resourceful Sales & Reservations Executive who can understand customer requirements, find suitable accommodation and successfully convert enquiries into bookings.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Enquiry & Sales Conversion

\* Handle incoming enquiries through calls, WhatsApp and the website.

\* Understand the customer’s location, dates, budget, property type and requirements.

\* Recommend suitable properties and guide customers towards booking.

\* Follow up with interested customers and close reservations.

2. Budget & Property Matching

\* Handle situations where the customer’s budget is lower than available property prices.

\* Identify suitable alternatives based on location, price, amenities and move-in readiness.

\* Coordinate with property owners and the inventory team for better pricing and availability.

\* Find practical solutions instead of simply informing customers that properties are unavailable.

3. Reservations & Booking Management

\* Confirm availability, pricing and booking conditions.

\* Coordinate with property owners and internal teams.

\* Obtain customer confirmation and support the payment and booking process.

\* Ensure accurate booking details and a smooth handover for check-in.

4. Customer Relationship Management

\* Maintain accurate enquiry records and follow-up schedules.

\* Identify reasons for lost enquiries and suggest improvements.

\* Build customer confidence through clear communication and reliable service.

Who Should Apply?

We particularly welcome candidates from:

\* PG, co-living and student accommodation sales

\* Residential rental brokerage and leasing

\* Travel agencies and holiday-package reservations

\* Hotel and serviced-apartment reservations

\* Used-car sales or other budget-focused consultative sales roles

Experience in handling price objections, product alternatives, customer negotiations and booking conversions is highly preferred.

Skills Required

\* Strong communication skills in Tamil and English.

\* Good negotiation and customer-handling abilities.

\* Ability to understand budgets and recommend practical alternatives.

\* Strong ownership of customer enquiries from first contact to booking.

\* Comfortable using CRM systems, WhatsApp and online booking tools.

\* Good knowledge of Chennai residential locations is an advantage.

\* Ability to work independently in a small, fast-moving team.

What We Expect

We are not looking for someone who simply makes calls, sends property details and waits for customers to respond.

We want someone who takes responsibility for converting genuine customer requirements into successful reservations.

You should be able to think independently, solve customer problems, negotiate effectively and work with the team to achieve predictable booking revenue.

Performance Expectations

Your performance will be measured through:

\* Qualified enquiries successfully converted into bookings.

\* Ability to find suitable properties within customer budgets.

\* Timely follow-up and reservation completion.

\* Accuracy of booking confirmations.

\* Customer satisfaction and successful check-ins.

What You Can Expect

\* Direct involvement in a growing accommodation business.

\* Practical experience in housing, reservations and property negotiations.

\* Opportunity to take ownership of sales and booking operations.

\* Career growth based on demonstrated performance and responsibility.**

title: Senior PMM (IC3)
description:
**About Everstage Inc.**
Everstage is the leading sales compensation and SPM platform. We automate commissions, quota and capacity planning, territory design, and real-time payout visibility for sales teams globally.
  
  
We're heading into the most exciting chapter of our story so far, a global brand refresh is about to go live, the leadership team is showing up more publicly and gaining followers and we want our social channels to feel less like a corporate handle and more like a creator brand.
  
  
That's where you come in.
  
  
**About The Role**
Everstage is hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market for major launches across our revenue platform: Everstage Incentives, Everstage Planning, and Everstage CPQ. You will own product storytelling and differentiation for your product areas, run projects end to end, and be accountable for launch impact. You will work directly with senior leaders in Product, Sales, and Customer Success, and help shape how customers experience and advocate for Everstage.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own GTM strategy for major product launches, from positioning and messaging through sales enablement, launch campaigns, and post-launch measurement.
* Lead product storytelling and differentiation, including how we position our AI capabilities against how buyers run incentives, quoting, and planning today.
* Develop market segmentation and narrative for key buyer personas: RevOps leaders, Sales Ops, Finance, and sales reps.
* Synthesize customer insights, competitive analysis, and market trends into sharper positioning, and bring those insights into roadmap conversations with Product leadership.
* Lead multi-format content campaigns across web, email, social, events, and sales enablement.
* Build sales tools that win deals: pitch decks, demo narratives, battle cards, and objection handling for competitive situations.
* Build and grow Everstage's customer marketing program: launch and manage a customer reference program, turn customer wins into case studies and video testimonials with measurable outcomes, grow our presence on peer review sites, recruit customers to speak at webinars and events, and set up structured feedback channels, such as customer interviews and advisory board sessions, that feed messaging and roadmap decisions.
* Influence cross-functional peers and leadership on launch priorities, timing, and success metrics.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3 to 5 years of product marketing experience in enterprise or technical B2B SaaS.
* Experience in Sales Performance Management (SPM), Incentive Compensation Management (ICM), or Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ). You know how RevOps, Sales Ops, and Finance teams buy and use these tools.
* Exceptional writing skills. You can take a complex concept and turn it into a clear, simple copy a busy RevOps leader understands in one read.
* Experience marketing AI products or AI-powered features, and a working knowledge of how buyers evaluate AI in enterprise software.
* A track record of owning major launches end to end, with results you can point to. You know how to bring Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing together around one plan and keep them aligned through launch day and beyond.
* Deep technical acumen. You can learn a complex product quickly and explain it in plain language tied to a business outcome.
* Comfort working with senior stakeholders and managing projects autonomously.
* Experience building and growing a customer marketing program is preferred. Ideally you have launched a reference program, shipped case studies and video testimonials, or run a customer advisory board, and you can show how that work helped Sales win deals.

title: Senior Manager – Technical Sales & Business Development
description:
**Senior Manager – Technical Sales & Business Development**

**Product:**
PSA Nitrogen Generators – TriEquion™

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Territory:**
Pan-India

**Experience:**
8+ years

**Engagement:**
Full-time

**About the Opportunity**

We are looking for a commercially driven and technically proficient professional to lead sales and market development for industrial PSA Nitrogen Generator systems across India.

The role is suited to an experienced Technical Sales professional who understands engineered industrial products and can translate technical specifications into practical customer solutions and business outcomes.

The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing customer relationships, understanding application requirements, presenting technical solutions, preparing commercial proposals and converting opportunities into orders.

In addition to individual sales ownership, the role will involve supervising and mentoring a junior team member, strengthening sales processes and contributing to the expansion of the business across relevant industrial segments.

**About the Product**

The role focuses on PSA (Pressure Swing Adsorption) Nitrogen Generator systems, including the TriEquion™ product range.

These systems generate nitrogen on-site for industrial applications where customers require a dependable nitrogen supply with specific purity, flow and pressure requirements.

The candidate should be capable of explaining the technology, understanding the customer's process requirements and demonstrating the commercial and operational value of on-site nitrogen generation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Sales & Business Development**

* Drive end-to-end sales of PSA Nitrogen Generator systems across India.
* Identify, qualify and develop new business opportunities across relevant industrial segments.
* Understand customer requirements relating to nitrogen purity, flow capacity, pressure, consumption and application.
* Translate technical requirements into appropriate product configurations and commercially viable solutions, working with engineering teams wherever required.
* Conduct customer meetings, technical presentations, product demonstrations and solution discussions.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and requirement assessment through proposal submission, negotiation and order closure.
* Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline to support business growth and revenue targets.

**2. Market Development & Industry Engagement**

* Develop a strong understanding of the Indian market for industrial nitrogen generation systems.
* Identify target customers, high-potential industries, geographic opportunities and new application areas.
* Build relationships with plant heads, engineering teams, operations leaders, procurement stakeholders, consultants, OEMs and system integrators.
* Explore opportunities across industries such as food processing and packaging, pharmaceuticals, electronics, metal processing and laser cutting, chemicals, petrochemicals and other nitrogen-intensive manufacturing applications.
* Monitor competitor offerings, market trends, customer expectations and pricing dynamics.
* Participate in industry exhibitions, technical seminars, customer events and other relevant marketing initiatives.
* Develop territory-level sales and market-development plans to improve market penetration.

**3. Technical Solutioning & Commercial Proposals**

* Develop a sound understanding of PSA technology, nitrogen generation, compressed-air requirements, system capacity, gas purity and operating economics.
* Explain product functionality, technical advantages, operational benefits and application suitability to prospective customers.
* Work closely with engineering and technical teams to validate customer specifications and recommend suitable solutions.
* Prepare and present technical and commercial proposals, quotations, cost estimates and supporting documentation.
* Develop customer-specific business cases covering operating costs, potential savings, total cost of ownership and return on investment.
* Support technical clarifications, commercial negotiations and solution validation throughout the sales process.
* Ensure that proposed solutions are aligned with customer requirements, product capabilities and commercial objectives.

**4. Customer Relationship Management**

* Establish and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Understand customer operating challenges and position solutions based on business value rather than price alone.
* Maintain regular engagement with key accounts and track opportunities for additional systems, upgrades and repeat business.
* Coordinate with engineering, project execution and service teams during order handover and project delivery.
* Support customer satisfaction and long-term account development.
* Resolve commercial and pre-sales queries in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.

**5. Sales Strategy, Planning & Reporting**

* Develop and execute annual, quarterly and monthly sales plans.
* Track sales pipeline, order bookings, revenue, conversion rates and forecast performance.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, customer information and opportunity-stage updates.
* Prepare periodic sales reports and business forecasts for leadership review.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of sales initiatives and identify opportunities to improve sales productivity.
* Contribute market intelligence and customer feedback to product, pricing and business strategy discussions.

**6. Team Management & Mentoring**

* Manage and guide a junior sales resource with approximately 3–5 years of experience.
* Allocate and review leads, customer follow-ups and sales activities.
* Provide technical guidance, product knowledge and coaching on consultative selling.
* Conduct periodic pipeline reviews and monitor individual and team sales performance.
* Support joint customer visits, proposal development and opportunity conversion.
* Establish disciplined processes for CRM updates, sales reporting and customer follow-up.
* Contribute to building a productive, accountable and customer-focused sales team.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in technical sales, industrial equipment sales, capital equipment sales or industrial business development.
* Demonstrated experience selling technically complex products or engineered industrial solutions.
* Proven ability to understand technical requirements and convert them into customer solutions and commercial opportunities.
* Experience managing the full sales cycle, including prospecting, solution discussions, proposals, negotiations and order closure.
* Strong customer engagement and relationship-management capabilities.
* Experience in sales planning, opportunity management, forecasting and reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor or supervise junior sales professionals.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across India.
* Strong verbal and written communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

**Preferred Technical & Industry Experience**

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred:

* PSA Nitrogen Generators or industrial gas-generation systems.
* Industrial gases and gas-handling solutions.
* Compressed-air systems and associated equipment.
* Process equipment, industrial machinery or capital equipment.
* Industrial automation and process technologies.
* Engineering solutions sold to manufacturing and industrial customers.

Familiarity with PSA technology, Carbon Molecular Sieve (CMS), nitrogen purity specifications, flow rates, operating pressure, compressed-air consumption and relevant industrial applications will be an advantage.

Direct experience selling PSA Nitrogen Generator systems would be particularly valuable.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Technical product understanding and consultative selling.
* Industrial market development and lead generation.
* Customer requirement analysis and solution positioning.
* Technical proposal and commercial quotation preparation.
* Negotiation and order closure.
* Pipeline management, sales forecasting and CRM discipline.
* Customer relationship and key-account development.
* Commercial awareness, including costing, margins and return on investment.
* Team supervision, mentoring and performance management.
* Planning, prioritization, communication and cross-functional collaboration.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance in this role will be evaluated against agreed business targets, including:

**Sales & Commercial Performance**

* Sales revenue and order bookings against target.
* Gross margin and commercial profitability.
* Qualified pipeline value and pipeline coverage.
* Proposal-to-order conversion rate.
* Sales forecast accuracy.

**Market Development**

* New customer acquisition.
* Qualified opportunities generated across target industrial segments.
* Growth in strategic accounts and geographic coverage.
* Development of effective customer, consultant, OEM and channel relationships.

**Sales Execution**

* Timeliness and quality of proposals.
* Opportunity progression and sales-cycle effectiveness.
* Accuracy of CRM data and reporting.
* Customer feedback and successful handover of orders to delivery teams.

**Team Effectiveness**

* Productivity and performance of the junior sales resource.
* Quality of pipeline reviews, coaching and follow-up discipline.
* Achievement of agreed team objectives.

Targets and weightages will be defined in line with business priorities and the annual sales plan.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a technically strong, commercially minded professional who can engage confidently with both engineering teams and business decision-makers.

They should be comfortable discussing technical specifications, identifying customer applications, demonstrating measurable business value and leading negotiations through to order closure.

They must also have the maturity to manage a junior resource, establish sales discipline and independently drive market development across India.

**We are looking for a professional who can understand the technology, communicate its value and turn that understanding into sustainable business growth.**

title: Medical Business Associate -  Chennai
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
You will engage with healthcare professionals across Chennai, building trust by sharing clear, science-based information that supports better patient care. In this role, you will design and deliver a territory plan focused on local needs and customer insights. Collaborating with colleagues from different teams, you will help solve challenges and improve patient access. We are looking for curious, honest, and practical thinkers who want to grow and make a meaningful impact. This role offers strong learning opportunities, career growth, and the chance to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Build and maintain respectful, professional relationships with doctors, pharmacists, and other healthcare partners in your territory.
* Develop and execute a territory business plan guided by customer insight and local patient needs.
* Share clear and accurate science-based information to support healthcare professionals’ decision-making.
* Record and report activities, outcomes, and customer insights accurately using company systems and tools.
* Collaborate with colleagues across functions to address customer needs and improve patient access.
* Continuously expand your knowledge of clinical evidence, market trends, and ways to enhance your performance.

Why You?
  
  
Work type
  
  
This is an on-site role based in Chennai, requiring regular travel within the assigned territory. You will be part of a supportive team that provides coaching and practical feedback. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. We value inclusion and strive to create a workplace where everyone can contribute and grow.
  
  
Basic Qualification
  
  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution.
* Minimum 1 year of customer-facing experience in field sales, medical business, or territory management.
* Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel regularly within the territory.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Tamil; knowledge of other local languages spoken in Chennai is a plus.
* Basic digital skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Right to work in India.

**Preferred Qualification**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Prior experience in pharmaceutical, medical, or healthcare-related roles.
* Comfortable discussing clinical evidence and explaining scientific concepts to healthcare professionals.
* Strong planning, organisation, and time management skills.
* Ability to use customer insight and simple data to guide your activities and priorities.
* Fluency in local languages spoken in and around Chennai.
* High motivation to learn, adapt, and take on increasing responsibility.

Ready to apply?
  
  
If this role fits your skills and ambitions, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and take the next step in your career while helping us unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Job Location - Chennai**
**Skills**
Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

The senior sales team will handle detailed product demonstrations, commercial discussions, negotiations, and final closures.

* Strong convincing and persuasion skills.

\* Willingness to travel to meet customers and develop new business opportunities.

\* Self-motivated, commercially focused and target-oriented, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with the team.

We welcome candidates who are passionate about industrial sales, customer relationship building and business development.**

RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing) and Project-based Hiring — both TARA\*-backed and non-TARA offerings

Enterprise deals with long sales cycles of 3–4 months

10+ years

Travel to client locations as required by the account base

Win new Industrial, Manufacturing and Mobility clients for Taggd — selling RPO and project-based hiring solutions to CHROs and Talent Acquisition Heads across Automotive, Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, EPC, Manufacturing and Logistics, and closing enterprise deals of ₹1 Crore and above against a ₹5 Crore annual new sales revenue target.

New Business Acquisition

* Own the ₹5Crore annual new sales revenue target, delivered primarily through new logos in the assigned segment.

Solution Selling and Deal Closure

* Run a consultative sales process — understand the client's hiring plan, volumes, roles and pain points before proposing a solution.

Pipeline and Forecasting

* Bring 10+ years of experience, with a consistent record of winning new logos in enterprise sales.

title: Sales Lead - B2B SAAS
description:
**Company:**
Fabriplay

**Location:**
Chennai

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–5 years in Sales / Business Development

**About Fabriplay**

Fabriplay is an IIT Madras-incubated FashionTech SaaS company transforming how bespoke clothing boutiques, tailors, and fashion designers manage their businesses. Our integrated platform digitizes customer management, measurements, appointments, order processing, production, billing, and business operations.

With 50+ paying clients and customers across India, France, Malaysia, and Sri Lanka, we are expanding our international footprint and building the digital infrastructure for the global bespoke fashion industry.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**hands-on Sales Lead**
who will take direct ownership of customer acquisition and revenue generation. This is an execution-focused role for someone who can independently identify prospects, initiate conversations, conduct product demonstrations, negotiate, and close deals.

The candidate will be responsible for achieving sales targets while establishing a structured, repeatable sales process that can support Fabriplay's growth. As the business expands, the role may also involve mentoring and guiding additional sales team members.

**This is not a purely managerial role. The Sales Lead is expected to personally drive sales activities and deliver measurable revenue results.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lead Generation & Prospecting**

* Proactively identify potential customers, including bespoke clothing boutiques, tailoring businesses, fashion designers, made-to-measure brands, and apparel SMEs.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified prospects through outbound calls, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, referrals, and other channels.
* Research target accounts and identify decision-makers, business needs, and opportunities for Fabriplay.
* Consistently execute daily outreach and follow-up activities to generate qualified sales opportunities.

**2. Product Demonstrations & Sales Conversion**

* Personally conduct online and in-person product demonstrations.
* Understand customer workflows, identify operational pain points, and position Fabriplay's value proposition accordingly.
* Explain product features, business benefits, pricing, and potential ROI.
* Handle objections, negotiate commercial terms, and convert prospects into paying customers.
* Own opportunities end-to-end, from the first conversation through payment and successful handover to Customer Success.

**3. Revenue Ownership**

* Own and achieve defined monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Convert qualified leads and product demos into paid subscriptions.
* Identify opportunities for higher-value plans, additional subscriptions, and referrals.
* Monitor conversion rates and sales cycle duration, and take corrective action when performance falls short.
* Provide accurate sales forecasts based on actual pipeline progress.

**4. Sales Process & Pipeline Management**

* Maintain an organized sales pipeline and customer records in the CRM.
* Establish disciplined follow-up schedules and ensure no qualified opportunity is neglected.
* Develop and improve sales scripts, email templates, demo workflows, objection-handling techniques, and closure strategies.
* Track daily activity and weekly performance against targets.
* Share customer insights and competitor feedback with the founders and Product team.

**5. Market Development & Partnerships**

* Explore new customer segments and geographic markets.
* Build relationships with fashion institutes, industry associations, boutique networks, and relevant channel partners.
* Support international customer acquisition and market expansion through direct outreach and partnerships.

**6. Team Development**

* Establish sales practices that can be replicated by future sales hires.
* Share proven outreach and conversion techniques with the team.
* Gradually take on mentoring and coordination responsibilities as the sales function grows.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or technology product sales.
* Proven experience in prospecting, conducting product demos, negotiating, and closing deals.
* Strong communication, presentation, objection-handling, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to independently manage a sales pipeline and achieve measurable targets.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, sales reporting, and pipeline management.
* Self-motivated, persistent, and comfortable working in a startup environment.
* Willingness to make outbound calls and engage prospects directly every day.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience selling SaaS subscriptions, CRM, ERP, retail technology, or business management solutions.
* Familiarity with fashion, apparel, tailoring, or boutique businesses.
* Experience with international customers or cross-border sales.
* Experience mentoring junior sales executives.

**Performance Metrics (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated primarily on measurable sales outcomes:

* Monthly revenue and new subscription bookings.
* Number of new paying customers acquired.
* Qualified leads generated.
* Product demos conducted and demo-to-paid conversion rate.
* Follow-up effectiveness and pipeline conversion.
* Average sales cycle and forecast accuracy.
* Customer acquisition through referrals and partnerships.

Targets will be defined based on the assigned market, pricing, available lead pipeline, and sales cycle.

**Compensation & Career Growth**

* Competitive fixed salary based on experience.
* Performance-based incentives linked to revenue and new customer acquisition.
* Opportunity to grow into Sales Manager or Head of Sales based on demonstrated results.
* Direct collaboration with the founders and exposure to international market expansion.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a sales professional who enjoys closing deals, takes personal accountability for revenue, and does not wait for leads to be handed over. They can build their own pipeline, communicate business value, handle rejection, and consistently convert prospects into paying customers.

**At Fabriplay, success is defined by revenue generated and paying customers acquired—not simply calls made, meetings attended, or reports prepared.**

title: Senior Pre-Sales Engineer Role (BMS & Fire Systems)
description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!
  
  
Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world.
