Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.
  
  
Job Description: Senior Pre-Sales Engineer Role (BMS & Fire Systems)
  
  
We are looking for a professional with a minimum of 15 years of experience in Building Management Systems (BMS) and Fire Alarm Systems (FAS). The candidate must have an Associate Degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering.
  
  
This role will be based in India, providing pre-sales engineering support to regional teams, with close collaboration with local country experts for site-specific, regulatory, and commercial inputs.
  
  
The role of a Senior Pre-Sales Engineer involves the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Conducting both preliminary and detailed pre-sales engineering to assess project suitability, understand requirements, and quantify scope for BMS and Fire Alarm tenders, including service, retrofit (A&A), and system migration projects
* Reviewing tender documents, site information, and available as-built drawings to identify system requirements, HVAC equipment, fire alarm systems, field devices, and interface points
* Reviewing sequence of operations and fire cause & effect, identifying gaps in specifications related to I/O summary and system requirements
* Preparing key deliverables such as RFIs, equipment summaries, data point schedules, loop/device schedules, and bills of material, including:
* Selection and sizing of BMS devices (sensors, valves, actuators, controllers)
* Selection and configuration of fire alarm systems (detectors, modules, panels – e.g., Sinteso EN)
* Definition of system interfaces and licenses
* Developing BMS and Fire system architecture, including integration with existing and third-party systems
* Producing technical compliance statements aligned with project specifications
* Working closely with local country experts to:
* Validate local fire code and regulatory compliance
* Incorporate actual site conditions and operational constraints
* Define scope boundaries and interfaces with other systems
* Supporting cost development by:
* Structuring and defining scope packages for subcontractors and suppliers
* Working with local teams, who will engage subcontractors and obtain budgetary quotations for relevant portions of the works
* Consolidating technical scope and cost inputs into the overall solution
* Recognising that supplier and subcontractor coordination, including quotation requests and commercial engagement, will be led by local country teams
* Identifying and mitigating technical and operational risks (e.g., legacy systems, live environment constraints), while capturing opportunities during tendering
* Preparing accurate project cost estimates, considering site constraints, phasing, and migration strategy
* Performing thorough quality checks on all deliverables prior to submission

**The Candidate Should Possess The Following Skills And Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of BMS, HVAC (ACMV), Electrical systems, and Fire Alarm Systems
* Understanding of fire system design principles, including cause & effect, zoning, and fail-safe operation
* Ability to work in a regional support model, collaborating effectively with local teams responsible for site validation, authority compliance, and supplier coordination
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills
* Understanding of basic instrumentation and control loops
* Ability to interpret single line diagrams, fire schematics, and floor plans (including incomplete as-built drawings)
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, M-Bus, KNX, and system integration interfaces
* Proficiency in MS Office, Bluebeam, and AutoCAD/Groundplan tools
* Knowledge of Revit and BIM will be an added advantage
* Additional knowledge in IT networking, cybersecurity, and industry compliance practices is advantageous
* Experience in service/retrofit environments or regional/global project support will be an added advantage.

This role is based in Chennai, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.
  
  
Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens
  
  
We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. **About Scano**
scanO is an AI-powered oral health screening platform, backed by the Google for Startups Accelerator. Our technology detects 40+ oral conditions from a scan, and is used by dental clinics across 9+ global markets including India, the UK, the UAE, South Africa and Singapore.
  
  
We are a team of 50+ in Pune, and we build the whole stack in-house: the computer vision models, the in-clinic hardware, the practitioner platform and the patient app.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
Every week, dentists and clinic owners reach out to us through our website, campaigns, webinars and expo booths. Someone has to pick up that interest quickly, understand what the clinic actually needs, explain what scanO does, and get the right prospects in front of our senior sales team.
  
  
That is this role. You are the first human voice a prospective customer hears, and the quality of that conversation decides whether a deal ever happens.
  
  
This is an inbound-first role. No cold call lists, no field visit targets. Outbound calling is limited to people who have already raised their hand: follow-ups, demo no-shows and older enquiries.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Lead handling and qualification**
Respond to inbound leads from web forms, campaigns, inbound calls, event enquiries and referrals. Run first-level discovery calls to understand the clinic profile, chair count, patient volume, who the real decision maker is, and how soon they intend to move.
  
  
**Product pitching**
Explain scanO’s capabilities and value clearly to dentists, clinic owners and healthcare partners. We will train you on the clinical and technical detail. What you bring is the ability to make it land inside a five-minute phone call.
  
  
**Pipeline management**
Book qualified leads into demo slots with the senior sales team, and own the follow-up discipline that gets prospects to actually turn up.
  
  
**CRM hygiene**
Log call notes, lead stage, qualification detail and next actions accurately, on the same day. Our forecasting depends on it.
  
  
**Market feedback**
Report recurring objections, pricing pushback, competitor mentions and feature requests to the marketing, product and sales teams. You hear the market before anyone else here does.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Experience: 0 to 2 years in inside sales, inbound sales, lead qualification or customer engagement. Product sales experience in SaaS, healthtech, dental, edtech, fintech or B2B is strongly preferred.

title: Assistant Manager- Outside Sales
description:
**Overview**
**IMI plc**
We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world — creating lasting impact for everyone.
  
  
We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control,
  
  
and Transport.
  
  
We employ approximately 10,000 people in over 50 countries around the world, find out more about lMl plc here
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Responsible for managing the assigned territory for India Aftermarket Controls business in full alignment with IMI CCI policies.
* Maintain strong customer relationships with all plants in the designated area.
* Conduct regular plant visits to support outage planning, improve plant performance, reduce downtime, and promote IMI CCI aftermarket solutions.
* Build and maintain long‑term relationships with plant owners/operators to secure ongoing business and future sales references.
* Plan and manage sales activities by ensuring accurate, up‑to‑date information in the CRM (SFDC).
* Stay informed about global and local market trends, upcoming projects, and relevant industry events within the assigned territory.

**Sales**

* Maintain and regularly update all commercial activities in the IMI CCI CRM as per management requirements.
* Stay informed on customer tender portals/sources and record them in CRM.
* Coordinate with inside sales to obtain and submit budgetary proposals for customer outages.
* Receive RFQs, translate/clarify, and forward them to inside sales promptly.
* Review proposals from inside sales and submit them to customers quickly, preferably in person.
* Actively follow up on submitted proposals.
* Forward customer purchase orders to inside sales immediately and assist with translations/clarifications.
* Support communication between inside sales/project management and customers to avoid shipment or payment issues.
* Assist finance with overdue cash collection when required.
* Promote IMI and IMI CCI Aftermarket functions during customer interactions.
* Attend IMI CCI meetings/conferences and contribute to overall business profitability.
* Collaborate with IMI CCI sales teams (Marketing, Nuclear, Upgrades, Follow-On) in IMI’s best interest.
* Work with Application Engineering and Technical Services to ensure optimal customer support.

**Plant Visits**

* Plan and conduct plant visits ahead of outages to promote IMI CCI aftermarket products and solutions and record all visits in the CRM.
* During visits, perform walk‑downs to inspect installed valves/controllers, take inspection notes, and update them in the CRM.
* Check warehouse inventories during plant visits and inform customers of replenishment needs.
* Carry appropriate and approved PPE to customer sites to safely perform inspections and inventory checks.

**Outage Management**

* Maintain and update planned outages at plants/units in the IMI CCI CRM tool.
* Being aware of the sources for information on plant outages and staying updated on this information, as well as reflecting it in the IMI CCI CRM tool.

**Forecasting**

* Keep the IMI CRM continuously updated with opportunities, outages, sales visits, OVC data, and other required inputs to ensure accurate forecasting.
* Prepare 5‑year sales forecasts for all active plants in the assigned territory within the CRM.
* Provide ongoing forecasts as required by management through the CRM and supply short‑term outage, OVC, and opportunity forecasts in other formats when requested.

**Desired Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/chemical/Instrumentation Engineering with 6-10 years in handling technical sales experience, preferably control valves, actuators, pumps, compressors, or other mechanically related equipment, preferably control valves or other mechanically related equipment.
* General working knowledge of Power Plants, Fertiliser, Oil & Gas production / processing facilities is preferable.
* Good understanding of commercial terms used in industry and knowledge of Sales Process including tender/enquiry process.
* Excellent time management and interpersonal skills essential.
* Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written required, in English & local language if any.

IMI is an inclusive employer; diversity is very important to us, and we want to receive applications from people from all backgrounds

**Organization Description:**
Jaipur Rugs is a social enterprise that connects rural craftsmanship with global markets through its luxurious handmade carpets. It is a family-run business that offers an exclusive range of hand-knotted and hand-woven rugs made using 2500 years old traditional art forms. The founder, Mr. Nand Kishore Chaudhary created a unique business model, which provides livelihood to the artisans at their doorstep. This changed the standard practice of involving middlemen to work with artisanal communities. The company currently has a network of over 40,000 artisans spread across 600 rural Indian villages in five states of India. It has an end-to-end business model, right from sourcing of wool to exporting a finished handmade rug.

The modern and eclectic collection of rugs, made using the finest wool and silk, has won numerous global awards and is currently exported to more than 45 countries with the US sales arm, Jaipur Living, Inc. located in Georgia, Atlanta.

**B. Sales Pipeline & Order Acquisition**

* Build, manage and convert a qualified sales pipeline into firm orders and sustainable business growth.
* Own the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and opportunity qualification to proposal submission, commercial negotiation and contract signing.
* Develop account plans for strategic customers and establish a strong customer engagement framework.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, opportunity reviews, order-book visibility and pipeline conversion plans.

**C. Tendering & Commercial Management**

* Lead techno-commercial proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, competitive bidding and tender strategy.
* Work with engineering, product, finance, legal, manufacturing and project execution teams to develop competitive and commercially viable solutions.
* Lead pricing, contract negotiations, payment terms, warranties, liquidated damages, performance guarantees and other commercial terms.
* Ensure disciplined margin management, credit-risk assessment and adherence to delegated commercial approval authorities.

**D. Product & Solution Selling**

* Develop a strong understanding of BESS technologies, including LFP battery systems, battery management systems (BMS), energy management systems (EMS), power conversion systems (PCS), thermal management, safety systems and grid integration.
* Translate customer requirements into commercially viable solutions in collaboration with technical and product teams.
* Position Powerhive's manufacturing and system-integration capabilities effectively against competing suppliers.
* Identify opportunities for localisation, product customisation, value engineering and differentiated customer offerings.

**E. Strategic Partnerships & Customer Relationships**

* Establish partnerships with EPC players, technology providers, system integrators and renewable energy developers.
* Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers across procurement, projects, engineering, finance and executive leadership.
* Represent Powerhive in industry forums, customer meetings, conferences and strategic business discussions.
* Develop a strong understanding of customer procurement cycles, financing models and project economics.

**F. Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Work closely with manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, project management and finance to ensure alignment between customer commitments and delivery capabilities.
* Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to guide product strategy and business planning.
* Build and lead a high-performing sales and business development team as the business scales.
* Establish effective CRM discipline, sales governance, review mechanisms and reporting processes.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Annual order inflow and achievement against the approved business plan.
* Qualified sales pipeline and pipeline coverage against order targets.
* Conversion rate of qualified opportunities and tenders.
* Gross margin and contribution from secured orders.
* New customer acquisition and growth in strategic accounts.
* Forecast accuracy and adherence to commercial approval processes.
* Customer retention, repeat business and customer satisfaction.
* Order quality, including payment terms, contractual risk and alignment with execution capacity.

**4. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical or Energy Engineering.
* MBA in Marketing, Sales, Strategy or a related discipline preferred.

**5. Experience & Competencies**

* 15–20 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or commercial leadership in power, renewable energy, batteries, energy storage or related infrastructure sectors.
* Demonstrable experience in winning large, complex techno-commercial orders and managing long sales cycles.
* Direct exposure to BESS, battery systems, power electronics, grid solutions or renewable energy integration is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of utility procurement, competitive tenders, project economics, pricing and contract negotiations.
* Established network among utilities, IPPs, renewable developers, EPC contractors and large industrial customers.
* Proven ability to build a business pipeline, close profitable orders and develop customer relationships from the ground up.
* Strong commercial judgement, strategic thinking, negotiation skills and cross-functional leadership capability.

**6. Target Candidate Organisations**

Candidates may be considered from BESS manufacturers and integrators, battery and power-electronics companies, renewable energy businesses, grid solutions providers and EPC organisations.

Potential target organisations include Fluence, Sungrow, Waaree, GoodEnough Energy, AmpereHour Energy, Delta Electronics, Hitachi Energy, ReNew and other relevant energy-storage or power-sector companies.

**7. Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven business leader who combines strong customer relationships with technical understanding of BESS and a demonstrated ability to secure profitable orders. The candidate must be comfortable operating in a growth-stage business, building the sales function and converting market opportunities into a sustainable order book.

title: Senior Regional Sales Enablement Manager– APAC
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
The Regional Sales Enablement Partner - APAC (RSEP) is a sales practitioner and enablement leader responsible for the readiness, coaching, and performance of Genesys' APAC field and partner sales organization. Bringing firsthand sales experience to the role, the RSEP builds trusted relationships with regional sales leaders and cross-functional partners to diagnose performance gaps, then designs and facilitates the coaching, training, and readiness programs that close them.
  
  
The RSEP is as comfortable in a live coaching conversation with a seller or manager as they are advising senior leadership on regional go-to-market priorities. They apply sales methodology expertise, data, and AI-enabled tools to sharpen judgment and scale impact — and they show up in the field, role-playing, shadowing calls, reviewing deals, and reinforcing skills in the flow of work. Ultimately, the RSEP is a trusted advisor and an adjunct member of the regional sales leadership team, measured on tangible improvements in seller performance and pipeline outcomes.
  
  
The RSEP is part of a global enablement team: some programs are built centrally at the global level, and the RSEP is responsible for tailoring and localizing them for APAC's markets, languages, and selling motions, while also feeding regional field insight back into how those global programs are designed. The RSEP is expected to operate fluently in both directions — shaping what gets built globally and making sure it lands regionally.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements:**

* 5+ years of experience working with Sales team (technology/SaaS strongly preferred), plus 5+ years in sales enablement, coaching, or sales performance roles, including experience leading enablement for a region or business unit; bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Proven track record coaching and developing sellers and front-line sales managers — through call/deal reviews, live shadowing, and structured 1:1 coaching — with measurable improvement in skills and results.
* Strong facilitation skills, with confidence leading in-person and virtual sessions for sellers, managers, and partners across diverse APAC audiences, languages, and time zones.
* Deep fluency in enterprise sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Value Selling, or similar), with the ability to embed it into everyday selling behavior rather than simply introduce it.
* Demonstrated credibility as a trusted advisor to sales leadership and cross-functional partners (Marketing, RevOps, Product, Partner/Channel), with the executive presence and influence-without-authority to shape decisions at senior levels.
* Data-driven approach — comfortable analyzing pipeline, conversion, and performance data (CRM, Clari, conversation-intelligence tools) to diagnose gaps and demonstrate enablement impact.
* Experience in a cloud/SaaS company, ideally supporting complex, multi-persona sales motions across direct and partner/channel teams.
* Experience operating as part of a global, matrixed enablement team — tailoring centrally-built global programs for regional nuance while feeding field insight back into global program design.
* Comfort leveraging AI-enabled tools to support coaching preparation, content development, and performance analysis, with a growth mindset toward new AI-supported approaches to enablement.
* Proficiency with the sales and enablement tech stack (CRM, Seismic, LMS/Lessonly or similar) and standard business tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Self-motivated, organized, and effective at managing multiple priorities in a fast-changing, matrixed environment.
* Fluency in languages outside of English a plus, particularly APAC regional languages.

**Key Responsibilities:**
The Regional Sales Enablement Partner spends the majority of their time directly engaged with sellers, managers, and leaders in the field — coaching, facilitating, and diagnosing performance gaps — while also shaping the regional enablement strategy that those activities feed into. Success in this role is measured by improvement in seller skill, pipeline quality, and win rate.
  
  
**Sales Coaching & Skill Development**

* Deliver 1:1 and team-level coaching to sellers and front-line sales managers to reinforce methodology and close specific skill gaps.
* Facilitate engaging, high-impact enablement sessions — in person and virtual — including role-play, negotiation practice, discovery and objection-handling drills, and certification workshops.
* Support new hire ramp to accelerate time-to-productivity and build early confidence.
* Design and deliver skills-based training aligned to the moments that matter most in a seller's day-to-day motion.

**Strategic Advisory & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to APAC sales leadership and cross-functional partners (Marketing, RevOps, Product, Partner/Channel), proactively surfacing performance gaps and enablement opportunities grounded in data and field insight.
* Build strong relationships with regional stakeholders to pinpoint knowledge and skills gaps, validating findings with data before recommending action.
* Bring firsthand field credibility into planning conversations, informing GTM and enablement priorities with real signal from coaching conversations, deal reviews, and seller feedback.
* Represent APAC's needs and constraints to the global enablement team, providing field-tested input that shapes how global programs are designed and where regional tailoring will be needed.
* Partner with global enablement peers and instructional designers to localize and adapt global programs for APAC's sellers, partners, and languages.

**Global Program Contribution & Regional Readiness**

* Tailor and localize globally-built enablement programs — content, methodology, and delivery format — for APAC's markets, languages, buyer dynamics, and selling motions, ensuring global programs actually change seller behavior in region.
* Own the quarterly readiness plan that brings global programs to APAC field and partner sales, translating global priorities and regional performance data into a prioritized, localized coaching and training calendar.
* Feed regional field insight — from coaching conversations, deal reviews, and seller feedback — back into the global team to inform how future global programs are designed and where global consistency vs. regional flexibility is needed.
* Apply AI-enabled tools to accelerate content localization, personalize coaching plans, and synthesize field feedback at scale.
* Maintain a consistent through-line between global enablement strategy and regional execution — flagging where global programs need adaptation and closing that loop with the global team.

**Performance Insights & Optimization**

* Partner with Sales Ops/RevOps to track how coaching and enablement activity moves pipeline creation, conversion rates, and seller productivity.
* Partner with first line managers to identify skill and performance trends, then convert them into targeted coaching interventions.
* Report enablement and coaching impact to leadership in clear, data-backed, executive-ready terms.

**Professionalism & Team Contribution**

* Exercise sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism in relationships with sellers, partners, and executive stakeholders.
* Contribute to broader Enablement Team initiatives and continuously develop personal coaching and facilitation craft.
* Travel: ~20% (key meetings/events + Annual Sales Kickoff).
* Remote, or based near a Genesys office, as required.
* Some early or late meetings required to accommodate our broader global team and varying time zones.

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.

Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

**About the role (Job Summary)**

You'll be talking to founders. Early-stage, fast-moving, often pre-revenue. They've booked a meeting with us because they know billing is a problem they need to solve. Your job is to confirm that, show them exactly what they need to see, and close.

**What you’ll do (role and responsibilities)**

* Positioning Chargebee not as a product but as growth infrastructure — something founders set up once and grow into, not something that slows them down
* Handling objections with clarity and confidence, not scripts — especially the tough ones around pricing, complexity, and why not just use the free plan
* Managing a high volume of accounts without losing the personal touch that closes early-stage founders

title: Co-Founder | Magma ChargeSpot | Sales, Growth & Business Development | Equity-Only (Pre-Seed)
description:
Please read this entire post before applying. It'll save both of us time.
 



  





*This is not a job.* 




 There is no salary at this stage. If you're looking for a monthly paycheck, this opportunity isn't the right fit.
 



  





 This is also not a side project. If you plan to keep your current job and "see how it goes," we're probably not a good match.
 



  





 I'm looking for someone who wants to build a company from the ground up and is willing to commit to creating something meaningful in exchange for real ownership.
 



  





**About Magma ChargeSpot** 




  





 Magma ChargeSpot is building a smart charging infrastructure platform that enables businesses to offer paid charging services for mobile phones, laptops, electric bikes, EVs, and other electronic devices.
 



  





 Our vision is to build one of India's largest smart charging networks across hotels, restaurants, malls, transport hubs, hospitals, educational institutions, apartments, workplaces, and retail spaces.
 



  





 We're developing our own hardware, embedded software, cloud platform, payment system, and charging management software to create a scalable charging ecosystem.
 



  





 We're currently at the early stage where the decisions we make today will define the company's future.
 



  





**About Me** 




 I'm Anish, Founder of Magma ChargeSpot.
 



 My background is in electronics, embedded systems, IoT, SaaS, and product development. I've built multiple technology ventures, including Firechip Electronics and Firechip Academy. My strength is designing and building products, not sales and marketing.
 



  





 That's why I'm looking for a complementary co\-founder.
 



  





**Who I'm Looking For** 




 Co\-Founder – Sales, Marketing \& Business Development
 



 You'll own the commercial side of the business.
 



  





 Your responsibilities will include:
 



 • Customer acquisition and enterprise sales
 



 • Building partnerships with hotels, malls, hospitals, parking operators, apartments, educational institutions, and corporate campuses
 



 • Brand building and marketing strategy
 



 • Channel and distribution development
 



 • Go\-to\-market strategy
 



 • Revenue growth
 



 • Investor presentations and business development
 



  





**What I'm Looking For** 




 You don't necessarily need experience in the EV industry.
 



  





 I'm looking for someone who:
 


* Loves meeting customers and closing deals
* Has experience in B2B sales or business development
* Can build partnerships from scratch
* Thinks like an owner, not an employee
* Is comfortable with uncertainty and startup life
* Wants to build a large company over the next 10\+ years



  





**What's on the Table** 



* Meaningful founder equity (subject to mutual agreement and standard vesting)
* A true co\-founder role with ownership over the commercial side of the company
* Direct involvement in company strategy, fundraising, and major business decisions
* The opportunity to help build one of India's leading charging infrastructure companies



  





**Expectations** 



* No salary initially
* Full\-time commitment
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and partnerships
* Preferably based in or willing to relocate to Chennai (flexible for the right person)
* Long\-term commitment



  





**Before You Apply** 




 Please don't apply if:
 


* You're looking for a salaried executive role
* You want to "try it for a few months"
* You're only interested after funding is secured
* You can't commit significant time to building the company



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send me:
 


1. Your resume
2. Your LinkedIn profile
3. A short note explaining why you want to build Magma ChargeSpot
4. How would you acquire our first 100 charging locations if you joined tomorrow



  





 If reading this excites you rather than makes you uncomfortable, I'd love to hear from you.
 



 Let's build something meaningful.
 



  





 — Anish R
 



 Founder, Magma ChargeSpot

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
**Title: Senior Sales Executive** 




**Work Location: Chennai** 




**Lindstrom Services India Private Limited** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 The Senior Sales Executive is responsible for driving
 **new business acquisition and revenue growth** 
 within the assigned territory. This role requires a strong focus on
 **direct B2B sales, customer engagement, and market development** 
 , along with the ability to build long\-term relationships and identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. New Business Acquisition** 



* Identify and target potential B2B customers within the assigned geography
* Generate and qualify leads through market mapping, networking, and industry engagement
* Drive end\-to\-end sales cycle including prospecting, client meetings, solution presentations, and deal closure
* Consistently achieve and exceed defined sales targets



**2\. Customer Relationship Management** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders such as Plant Managers, Procurement Heads, and Business Owners
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and issue resolution
* Strengthen client relationships to drive repeat business and long\-term partnerships



**3\. Account Growth \& Retention** 



* Identify opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling across existing accounts
* Drive account expansion by understanding customer needs and aligning solutions accordingly
* Monitor customer health and take proactive actions to ensure retention



**4\. Market Intelligence \& Business Insights** 



* Stay informed on industry trends, customer expectations, and competitor activities
* Gather and share market insights to support product, pricing, and service improvements
* Contribute to identifying new market opportunities and business segments



**5\. Sales Planning \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of sales activities, pipeline, and forecasts in CRM systems
* Track performance against targets and provide regular updates to stakeholders
* Ensure discipline in sales processes and reporting standards



  





**Key Requirements:** 



* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 3 years of experience in B2B / corporate sales
* **Sales Capability:** 
 Proven track record in lead generation, direct sales, and deal closure
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Ability to engage, influence, and build credibility with senior decision\-makers
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Strong presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
* **Tools \& Systems:** 
 Working knowledge of CRM platforms, MS Office, and digital sales tools
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred)
* **Mobility:** 
 Willingness to travel extensively for business development



  





**Key Competencies:** 




**1\. New Business Hunting Mindset** 



* Demonstrates a strong drive to
 **identify and convert new business opportunities**
* Proactively pursues leads and builds a healthy sales pipeline



**2\. Consultative Selling Ability** 



* Understands customer needs and translates them into
 **relevant, value\-driven solutions**
* Moves beyond transactional selling to
 **solution\-based conversations**



**3\. Stakeholder Influence \& Relationship Building** 



* Builds credibility and trust with
 **senior decision\-makers (Plant Heads, Procurement, etc.)**
* Navigates complex B2B buying environments effectively



**4\. Commercial Acumen** 



* Understands pricing, margins, and business impact
* Negotiates effectively while ensuring
 **win\-win outcomes**



**5\. Execution Discipline** 



* Maintains strong control over
 **sales pipeline, follow\-ups, and closures**
* Demonstrates consistency in achieving targets and meeting deadlines



**6\. Market Awareness \& Adaptability** 



* Stays updated on
 **industry trends, competition, and customer expectations**
* Adapts sales approach based on market dynamics

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 IECHM Technology Private Limited is a one\-stop OEM manufacturer based in Chennai, India, specializing in taking product ideas from concept to mass production under one roof. The company manages the complete product development cycle on its own machines, with no outside vendors or handoffs. IECHM offers free design, engineering, and consultation services, supporting clients from initial idea or sketch through 3D modeling, custom electronics, simulation, and validation. The organization manufactures products across sectors other than chemical and textile, allowing partners to engage at any stage, from prototype to full production. IECHM is focused on turning ideas into high\-quality, real\-world products through integrated concept, design, engineering, and manufacturing capabilities.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time remote role for a Field Sales Executive at IECHM Technology Private Limited. The Field Sales Executive will identify and qualify prospective clients, build and maintain relationships, and promote IECHM’s end\-to\-end OEM manufacturing services. Daily responsibilities include conducting virtual and field\-based meetings, presenting solutions based on client needs, preparing proposals and quotations, and following up to close opportunities. The role involves coordinating closely with internal engineering and production teams to align customer requirements with feasible solutions and timelines. The Field Sales Executive will also track sales activities, maintain accurate CRM records, provide market feedback, and contribute to sales targets and revenue growth.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Sales and business development skills, including lead generation, prospecting, negotiation, and closing deals.
* Customer relationship management skills, such as stakeholder communication, account management, and post\-sales support.
* Understanding of manufacturing or engineering services, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into clear value propositions.
* Strong presentation, documentation, and proposal\-writing skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Comfort with remote work tools, CRM systems, and digital collaboration platforms.
* Relevant experience in field sales or B2B sales, preferably in manufacturing, engineering, or industrial solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work independently, travel as needed to client sites, and manage time and territory effectively.
* Professional communication skills in English; additional regional language skills are an advantage.

title: Telesales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 DETRON India CNC Rotary Tables is associated with detron Machinery Co. Ltd., Taiwan, one of the world’s largest professional rotary table manufacturers. detron focuses on designing and engineering high\-quality NC rotary table products, driven by an experienced international R\&D team. The company’s mission is to understand and support customer needs through advanced application technology and a wide range of products that deliver optimum performance. Intelligent design ensures easy integration of their rotary tables with diverse machine tools, enabling efficient and reliable manufacturing solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time Telesales Executive role is an on\-site position based in Chennai. The Telesales Executive will make outbound calls to prospective and existing customers to promote CNC rotary tables and related solutions, explain product features, and understand customer requirements. The role involves generating and qualifying leads, maintaining accurate records of interactions in the CRM system, and following up consistently to convert opportunities into sales. The Telesales Executive will respond to inquiries, coordinate with the sales and technical teams for quotations or product demonstrations, and contribute to achieving individual and team sales targets. The position also includes providing basic customer support over the phone and sharing customer feedback to improve service and product offerings.

title: Structural Steel Sales Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 SISCOL (Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited) delivers end\-to\-end structural steel solutions that support India’s key infrastructure projects, including airports, metro systems, bridges, seaports, high\-rise buildings, and industrial hubs. Led by experienced professionals from the steel and infrastructure sectors, the company focuses on precision, faster build times, design flexibility, and sustainability. SISCOL operates state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in Bhilai, Hyderabad, and Vadodara, along with design and engineering centers in Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, and Bhilai. The organization is committed to delivering projects to global standards across India, positioning structural steel at the center of modern infrastructure. SISCOL’s mission is to help build a stronger, smarter, and faster\-growing India through innovative steel solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Structural Steel Sales Engineer role based in Chennai. The role involves identifying and pursuing sales opportunities for structural steel solutions, managing client relationships, and preparing technical and commercial proposals. The Sales Engineer will collaborate with design, engineering, and project teams to translate client requirements into feasible technical solutions and ensure accurate quotations. Day\-to\-day activities include conducting site visits, providing pre\- and post\-sales technical support, delivering product presentations, and participating in negotiations to close orders. The role also includes maintaining CRM records, tracking market trends, and supporting business development initiatives to expand SISCOL’s presence in the region.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills, with the ability to interpret structural steel designs and specifications.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Customer Service skills to build relationships, manage accounts, and ensure client satisfaction.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for presenting solutions, coordinating with internal teams, and preparing clear documentation.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in structural steel, construction, or infrastructure projects will be an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site with clients and project teams, including occasional travel as required.
* Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with basic engineering drawings or CAD tools is beneficial.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving abilities, with a focus on achieving sales targets ethically and collaboratively.

 who can take complete ownership of our sales function and build a high\-performing sales team.

 **hands\-on, result\-oriented Sales Manager**

* Identify bottlenecks in the sales process and implement corrective actions.
* Improve lead\-to\-demo and demo\-to\-enrollment conversion rates.
* Track revenue, enrollments, average ticket size, conversion rates, and other key sales metrics.
* Build predictable and scalable sales processes for long\-term growth.

* Conduct daily sales reviews and performance tracking.
* Monitor counsellor productivity, follow\-ups, conversions, and revenue contribution.

* Train the team on product knowledge, sales pitch, objection handling, follow\-ups, and closing.
* Build a performance\-driven and accountable sales culture.


 Sales Process \& Operations

* Ensure proper CRM usage and accurate sales reporting.
* Analyse sales data and identify trends and opportunities.
* Create sales dashboards and reports for management review.
* Establish effective lead allocation and follow\-up systems.
* Ensure leads are followed up systematically and within defined timelines.
* Continuously experiment with new sales approaches to improve conversions.


 Long\-Term Growth
 * Build a scalable sales organisation as Spellzee expands.
* Develop Team Leads and future sales leaders.
* Create structured sales training and onboarding systems.
* Identify opportunities to increase customer acquisition, revenue, retention, and referrals.
* Work with the leadership team on long\-term sales strategy and expansion plans.
* Take ownership of solving sales challenges instead of waiting for instructions.


 Mandatory Requirement
 
**Prior K12 EdTech sales experience is mandatory.** 




 Candidates without K12 EdTech sales experience will not be considered for this role.
 



 Candidates should have hands\-on experience in areas such as:
 


* K12 EdTech counselling/sales
* Inside sales
* Online education sales
* Parent counselling
* High\-volume lead management
* Demo\-to\-enrollment conversion
* Sales team management
* Revenue target management


 Skills Required
 * Strong K12 EdTech sales experience.
* Proven experience in achieving sales/revenue targets.
* Strong team management and leadership skills.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Strong understanding of sales funnels and conversion metrics.
* Data\-driven approach to sales management.
* Strong coaching and mentoring ability.
* Excellent objection\-handling and closing knowledge.
* CRM experience.
* Ability to analyse sales performance and take corrective actions.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to build systems rather than depending only on individual performance.


 Who We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Thinks like a
 **sales owner** 
 , not just a sales supervisor.
* Takes responsibility for numbers and outcomes.
* Is comfortable being measured against revenue and conversion targets.
* Can identify problems independently and take action.
* Can coach and develop salespeople.
* Understands both
 **people management and numbers** 
 .

title: Sales Account Executive
description:
**About Chargebee** 




 Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.
 



  





 Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2\.
 



 With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.
 



  





**About the role (Job Summary)** 




 You'll be talking to founders. Early\-stage, fast\-moving, often pre\-revenue. They've booked a meeting with us because they know billing is a problem they need to solve. Your job is to confirm that, show them exactly what they need to see, and close.
 



  





**What you’ll do (role and responsibilities)** 



* Running inbound discovery and closing calls with early\-stage startup founders across the US and EMEA — companies with fewer than 10 employees, often pre\-revenue or under $100K ARR.
* Qualifying prospects fast, identifying the right offer, and closing deals in one call wherever possible.
* Working multiple lead sources — inbound demo bookings, form applications, high\-growth trial accounts, and warm handoffs — each with a different approach.
* Positioning Chargebee not as a product but as growth infrastructure — something founders set up once and grow into, not something that slows them down.
* Handling objections with clarity and confidence, not scripts — especially the tough ones around pricing, complexity, and why not just use the free plan.
* Managing a high volume of accounts without losing the personal touch that closes early\-stage founders.



  





**What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)** 




  




* You have a good grasp of the product — you don't need to be an expert on every feature, but you understand what we solve and for whom
* You have 2\-4 years of work experience
* Good problem solving skills — ability to simplify complex problems and provide solution to the customers
* Understand what a good customer conversation looks like
* You can run a focused, story\-driven conversation — you sell the outcome, not the feature list
* You're comfortable making quick decisions — which offer to lead with, when to push, when to listen
* You write clearly and concisely — a lot of this motion runs on sharp emails that move deals forward without scheduling unnecessary calls
* You manage your time well independently — this is a high\-volume role and things move fast

The role also involves conducting site visits, supporting installation planning from a sales perspective, providing pre\- and post\-sales technical support, and contributing to forecasts, sales reports, and market intelligence. title: Store Manager (Retail, Cosmetics, Chennai)
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **Store Manager** 
 to manage the operations and business performance of a premium beauty and cosmetics retail store in
 **Chennai** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving store sales, delivering an exceptional customer experience, managing and developing the store team, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operations. The role also involves building relationships with
 **beauty academies, salons and professional makeup/beauty businesses** 
 to create new business opportunities and strengthen the store's presence in the market.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced retail professional who understands the
 **premium beauty, cosmetics or professional makeup industry** 
 and enjoys working in a customer\-facing, target\-driven environment.
   

  

* Deliver excellent service to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Motivate the sales team to meet sales objectives by training and mentoring staff.
* Create business strategies to attract new customers, expand store traffic, and enhance profitability.
* Ensure business growth year on year basis.
* Plan regular visit to different Academies and Salons for business tie\-ups.
* Delegate work to store team to ensure store operations run smoothly and mointor them closely.
* Follow store SOP and ensure all other staffs follow the same.
* Create weekly staff roster and plan resource for supporting training team and marketing team whenever needed.
* Hire, train, and oversee new staff.
* Respond to customer complaints and concerns in a professional manner.
* Ensure store compliance with health and safety regulations and follow industrial standards.
* Develop and arrange promotional material and in\-store displays.
* Prepare detailed reports on buying trends, customer requirements, and profits.
* Undertake store administration duties such as managing store budgets and updating financial records.
* Monitor inventory levels and order new items.
* Maintain store monthly report and conduct periodic inventory audits.
* Take care store maintenance work whenever needed.


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience in retail store management, preferably in cosmetics, beauty, premium/luxury retail or related categories.
* Experience managing a team and store sales targets.
* Strong understanding of retail operations, customer experience and sales management.
* Experience in premium beauty, cosmetics, professional makeup, salon or beauty\-related businesses will be preferred.
* Exposure to working with beauty academies, salons, makeup artists or professional beauty customers is an advantage.
* Strong people\-management skills with the ability to train, mentor and motivate a sales team.
* Proven ability to drive store revenue, customer acquisition and year\-on\-year business growth.
* Good understanding of inventory management, stock audits and store administration.
* Experience in visual merchandising and in\-store promotions.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Comfortable with field visits and developing business tie\-ups with salons and academies.
* Ability to handle customer complaints and resolve issues professionally.
* Good analytical skills with the ability to prepare and interpret sales, inventory and store performance reports.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of store performance.
* Candidates currently working with premium cosmetics, beauty, professional makeup, salon or luxury retail brands will be preferred.
* Chennai\-based candidates or candidates willing to relocate to Chennai are

title: Sales Engineer : Hyderabad and Bengaluru
description:
About SUSBIO :
 



 Since 2013, SUSBIO has been designing and manufacturing packaged sewage and effluent
 



 treatment plants. ECOTREAT is our flagship range of advanced prefabricated STPs, used by
 



 builders, housing societies, hotels, hospitals, institutions, and industries that need reliable wastewater
 



 treatment with minimal civil work and fast installation. We're based in South Goa, manufacture in
 



 Chakan (Pune), and are now building our team in Hyderabad and Bangalore.
 



  





 The role :
 



 You'll own sales of ECOTREAT advanced prefabricated STPs in your city, from first conversation to
 



 purchase order. That means finding projects early, talking to the people who decide (developers,
 



 architects, MEP consultants, facility heads), sizing the right plant, and closing. You won't be selling a
 



 catalogue item. You'll be helping customers solve a compliance and water\-reuse problem, and you'll
 



 need enough engineering to do it credibly.
 



  





 What you'll do :
 



 • Generate and qualify leads from builders, developers, MEP and environmental consultants,
 



 hospitals, hotels, and industrial clients
 



 • Visit sites, understand flow, load, space, and discharge norms, and recommend the right
 



 ECOTREAT configuration
 



 • Work with our design team to prepare technical proposals, capacity calculations, and commercial
 



 offers
 



 • Present to customers and consultants, and handle technical and pricing questions
 



 • Negotiate, close orders, and coordinate handover to our projects and service teams
 



 • Build relationships with architects, consultants, and channel partners in your city
 



 • Track leads and follow\-ups in our CRM and report your pipeline weekly
 



 • Keep an eye on local pollution control board norms and competitor activity
 



 What we're looking for
 



 • B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Environmental, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (a related diploma with
 



 strong experience is also fine)
 



 • 2\-3 years in sales or business development for STPs, water treatment, prefabricated or modular
 



 systems, or a similar product line
 



 • Good grasp of STP basics and pollution control norms, or the ability to pick them up quickly
 



 • Comfortable reading drawings and estimating capacities
 



 • Good communicator in English and the local language (Telugu/Hindi in Hyderabad, Kannada/Hindi
 



 in Bangalore)
 



 • Self\-driven and comfortable with frequent site visits and travel within the city
 



 • A network among builders, consultants, or contractors in your city is a strong plus
 



 What you get
 



 • Salary in line with industry standards, based on your experience
 



 • Very lucrative monthly incentives linked to the orders you close
 



  





 • Direct access to the founders and a real say in how we grow in South India
 



 • Technical training on ECOTREAT from the team that designs and builds it
 



 • Travel and mobile allowance as per policy
 



  





 Locations :
 



 Hyderabad and Bangalore (one position per city)
 



  





 How to apply
 



 Send your CV to jacob@susbio.in and akshat@susbio.in with the subject line "Sales Engineer,
 



 \[Hyderabad/Bangalore]".

* Provide end\-to\-end leasing advisory services for office space acquisition, renewal, consolidation, and relocation.
* Prepare and present market intelligence, availability reports, lease comparisons, and financial analysis.

 Transaction Management

 Prospect → Qualify → Pitch → Propose → Negotiate → Close → Retain → Upsell The agency will provide digital marketing expertise and delivery support, but lead generation and business development will primarily be the responsibility of the Sales \& Key Account Manager.

 Must\-Have

 Good to Have

 · Experience selling digital marketing retainers.
 



  





 · Experience with performance marketing or lead\-generation services.
 



  





 · Experience managing high\-value accounts.
 



  





 · Experience working in a digital agency environment.
 



  





  





 Success in This Role
 



  





 · Consistently achieve monthly and quarterly new business revenue targets.
 



  





 · Build a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities and convert them into new clients.
 



  





 · Improve average deal value and generate strong gross margin.
 



  





 · Grow existing strategic accounts through upselling and cross\-selling.

 · Build and maintain approximately 10–20 clients at the target average retainer level while continuously replacing churn and increasing account    revenue.

* 5–10 years in technology presales, GTM, or solution consulting roles in tech services, consulting, or SaaS/product firms.

**Value Creation Strategy
 *(Core Focus)***

 Forsche.ai

* Submit regular sales activity reports and pipeline updates.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in B2B sales, preferably in the Education or EdTech sector.
* Experience in selling products or services to schools, colleges, universities, or educational institutions is highly preferred.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Strong relationship\-building and customer engagement abilities.
* Ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
* Good knowledge of CRM software and Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience in preparing proposals, quotations, and business presentations.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Knowledge of AI, Robotics, EdTech, Skill Development, or Digital Learning solutions.
* Strong networking and business development capabilities.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills.
* Ability to identify new market opportunities and convert them into business.
* Travel Requirements
* Willingness to travel within Chennai and other locations for client meetings and business development activities.

**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI, Robotics, and Education Technology solutions.
* Exposure to innovative products and digital transformation initiatives.
* Performance\-based incentives and rewards.
* Professional growth and leadership opportunities.
* Collaborative, learning\-oriented, and technology\-driven work environment.

 At

title: Sales Specialist - Advertising
description:
Role: Sales Specialist/ Business Development
 



 Purpose / Role Summary: The Sales Executive will drive client acquisition, conversion, and onboarding. This role is responsible for pitching the agency’s services (creative design, immersive branding, experience\-based branding, packaging, etc.), bringing in new business, managing lead generation, and working closely with the Account / Delivery team to ensure new clients are onboarded smoothly.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 



 ● Identify, outreach and engage potential clients / brands / businesses that could benefit from the company's creative / experiential / branding offerings.
 



 ● Generate leads via networking, digital outreach, referrals, social media presence, market research, etc.
 



 ● Understand prospects’ needs, pitch relevant services (branding, packaging, immersive and spatial branding, experiential design) with customized proposals.
 



 ● Collaborate with creative/design leads to prepare pitch decks, creative proposals, budgets, timelines, deliverables.
 



 ● Present and negotiate proposals / contracts with prospective clients; manage deal closure.
 



 ● Ensure smooth handover to Account Director / Delivery Team upon client conversion — coordinate onboarding, brief collection, kickoff, and offboarding.
 



 ● Maintain and update the sales pipeline, CRM (or tracking system), lead databases, follow\-ups, conversion metrics.
 



 ● Meet or exceed defi ned sales targets / conversion metrics / revenue targets.
 



 ● Keep abreast of market trends, competitor offerings, and evolving demand in branding, packaging, immersive design, experiential branding.
 



 ● Work collaboratively with the marketing / social media / outreach team (if any) to amplify outreach efforts.
 



 ● Provide feedback from clients/market to agency leadership about market needs, demand gaps, service refi nement opportunities.
 



 Skills \& Experience Required:
 



 ● Experience: 2–5 years (or more) in sales / business development — ideally with exposure to creative agencies, design studios, branding/marketing fi rms, or creative services.
 



 ● Strong communication, negotiation, presentation skills.
 



 ● Understanding of creative services, design, branding, packaging — ability to grasp what the company offers, and articulate value proposition to clients.
 



 ● Client\-facing confi dence, networking ability, sales\-oriented mindset, result\-driven, self\-motivated.
 



 ● Good interpersonal skills — ability to coordinate between clients and internal design/creative team, and ensure smooth onboarding.
 



 ● Basic understanding of project cycles, deliverables, timelines (even if not executing), to ensure promises match delivery capacity.
 



 ● Profi ciency in CRM tools, MS Offi ce / Google Workspace, proposal \& presentation tools (PowerPoint / Google Slides), quoting / budgeting basics.
 



 ● Ability to multitask — handle multiple leads / prospects at different stages.
 



 ● Comfortable working in a creative, fast\-changing environment; fl exible to adapt pitches to different kinds of clients (brands, businesses, projects).
 



 Education / Other Preferences:
 



 ● Graduation in Business, Marketing, Communications, or any equivalent discipline.
 



 ● Prior experience or interest in creative industries (branding, design, packaging, branding agencies).
 



 ● Basic knowledge of design/branding jargon, packaging/experiential\-design workfl ows is a plus (so candidates can converse meaningfully with creative leads).
 



 ● Good social media awareness, digital marketing sensibility (since the company seems active on social media and branding). Instagram\+1
 



 Compensation \& Benefi ts (to be defi ned by client):
 



 ● Base salary \+ commission / incentive based on conversions / sales targets
 



 ● Opportunity to grow into senior BD / account roles as business scales
 



 ● Exposure to creative branding / immersive design assignments with reputed clients
 



 KPIs / Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months):
 



 ● Number of new clients onboarded / conversion rate from leads
 



 ● % Revenue generated from new clients
 



 ● Quality of leads: clients whose requirements align well and result in sustainable projects (not one\-offs)
 



 ● Smooth handover to delivery team and minimal client\-onboarding issues or dropouts
 



 ● Contribution to business growth / expansion of client base and company growth

title: District Account Manager - VELYS
description:
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
   

  

 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
   

  

**Job Function**
 MedTech Sales
   

  

**Job Sub Function**
 Clinical Sales – Surgeons (Commission)
   

  

**Job Category**
 Professional
   

  

**All Job Posting Locations:**
 Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, PENJERLA, Telangana, India
   

  

**Job Description**
 About DePuy Synthes
   

  

 At DePuy Synthes, we are transforming orthopaedic care through intelligent technologies, data\-driven insights, and robotic\-assisted surgery. As part of Johnson \& Johnson MedTech, we are committed to advancing patient outcomes through innovation, education, and clinical excellence.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity to work with industry\-leading robotic and digital surgery platforms, collaborate with renowned surgeons, and contribute to the adoption of next\-generation surgical technologies. We provide world\-class training, professional development, and a dynamic environment where high performers can build a rewarding career.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The District account manager – Digital Surgery is responsible for driving adoption and utilization of Digital Surgery solutions, including robotic\-assisted surgery platforms, navigation technologies, and data\-enabled surgical workflows within the assigned territory.
   

  

 The role focuses on executing surgeon conversion strategies, developing customer partnerships, supporting clinical excellence, and achieving sales and utilization targets. The District account manager will collaborate closely with Joint Reconstruction sales teams, marketing, clinical specialists, and hospital stakeholders to accelerate the adoption of Smart Surgery solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Business Development \& Sales Growth
   

  

* Drive sales growth and market expansion of Digital Surgery solutions within the assigned territory.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to increase adoption of robotic\-assisted surgery technologies.
* Identify, prioritize, and convert target surgeons, hospitals, and healthcare systems through structured conversion plans.
* Achieve or exceed assigned sales, utilization, and market development targets.
* Build a sustainable pipeline of opportunities and maintain accurate forecasting.


 Surgeon Engagement \& Customer Development
   

  

* Establish strong relationships with key orthopaedic surgeons, hospital administrators, theatre managers, and clinical teams.
* Drive surgeon conversions through evidence\-based discussions, clinical value propositions, and workflow optimization.
* Support surgeon onboarding and adoption programs to ensure successful technology implementation.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers by demonstrating clinical, operational, and economic value.


 Clinical \& Technical Support
   

  

* Provide in\-theatre support during robotic\-assisted procedures and technology\-enabled surgeries.
* Deliver product demonstrations, workshops, and educational programs for surgeons and operating room staff.
* Ensure customers are trained and confident in the utilization of Digital Surgery technologies.
* Collaborate with Clinical Specialists to maximize utilization and customer satisfaction.


 Strategic Account Management
   

  

* Develop territory business plans aligned with regional and national objectives.
* Monitor competitive activities, market trends, and customer needs to identify growth opportunities.
* Drive capital equipment opportunities through effective stakeholder engagement and value\-based selling.
* Support contract negotiations, business reviews, and technology utilization assessments.


 Cross\-functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner closely with Joint Reconstruction Sales, Marketing, Clinical Education, Professional Education, and Service teams.
* Support product launches, customer education initiatives, and strategic marketing programs.
* Contribute to best\-practice sharing and continuous improvement initiatives across the Digital Surgery business.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Achievement of Digital Surgery sales targets.
* Surgeon conversion and adoption metrics.
* Robotic utilization growth.
* New account acquisition and account penetration.
* Customer satisfaction and retention.
* Market share growth within assigned territory.
* Training and education program effectiveness.
* Forecast accuracy and pipeline development.


**Essential**
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Physiotherapy, Healthcare, Business, or related discipline.
* Demonstrated success in medical device, healthcare technology, orthopaedics, or capital equipment sales.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and highly technical environment.
* Strong business acumen and analytical mindset.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Preferred**
* Experience in Orthopaedics, Joint Reconstruction, Surgical Navigation, Robotics, Digital Health, or Operating Theatre environments.
* Experience supporting surgeons during surgical procedures.
* Knowledge of robotic\-assisted surgery technologies and healthcare digital transformation.
* Experience influencing multiple stakeholders in complex hospital sales environments.


 Desired Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Thinking
* Customer Centricity
* Commercial Excellence
* Technical Aptitude
* Clinical Credibility
* Influencing \& Negotiation Skills
* Problem Solving
* Collaboration \& Teamwork
* Adaptability and Resilience
* Results Orientation


 Why Join Us?
   

  

* Work with industry\-leading robotic and digital surgery technologies.
* Comprehensive onboarding and world\-class training programs.
* Opportunities for rapid career growth within Johnson \& Johnson MedTech.
* Competitive compensation and incentive programs.
* Collaborative and inclusive culture.
* Access to award\-winning leadership development programs.
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on surgeon outcomes and patient care.


**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
 Account Management, Business Behavior, Collaboration, Cultural Competence, Customer Analytics, Customer Centricity, Execution Focus, Healthcare Trends, Issue Escalation, Market Knowledge, Market Research, Medical Technology, Sales, Sales Support, Solutions Selling, Sustainable Procurement, Vendor Selection

title: Manager – Revenue (Chennai)
description:
**About The Team**
 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Revenue \& P\&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions


**Who We Are Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution \[IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e\-commerce operations, or P\&L\-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment


 Good to Have
   

  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on\-ground activation


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P\&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High\-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

 About the Role:

 of each store depends heavily on the quality, ownership mindset, and operating capability of
   

  

 the franchise partner.

 network.
